//
// Hoists chains of index-transform ops (ops implementing
// MAP::IndexTransformOpInterface, e.g. map.index.slice) out of any
// CapturingFusionClosure (map.iter.elementwise.body, map.iter.prologue,
// map.iter.epilogue) into a chain of "stride" ops (e.g.
// map.index.slice.stride) in the enclosing map.iter.opaque, so the transform
// runs once per kernel invocation instead of once per loop index.
//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Dialect/MAPOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/Support/DataflowUtils.h"
#include "mlir/IR/Builders.h"
#include "mlir/IR/IRMapping.h"

using namespace M;
using namespace mlir;

namespace M::MAP {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_LOOPINVARIANTVIEWMOTION
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h.inc"

namespace {

// Walks backward from `index` through a chain of index-transform ops,
// closest-to-load first, stopping at the first value that isn't one
// (typically the closure's own index block argument).
SmallVector<IndexTransformOpInterface> collectIndexTransformChain(Value index) {
  SmallVector<IndexTransformOpInterface> chain;
  Value current = index;
  while (Operation *def = current.getDefiningOp()) {
    auto transform = dyn_cast<IndexTransformOpInterface>(def);
    if (!transform)
      break;
    chain.push_back(transform);
    current = transform.getIndex();
  }
  return chain;
}

// Whether `op`'s result reaches a `map.store` index, directly or through
// further index transforms. Such an op maps an INDEX, not a tensor, so it
// cannot become a `.stride` view and stays in the closure. A load-side view
// composed on a store-index transform still hoists (e.g. a broadcast on a
// reshaped store index hoists; the reshape stays). The walk stays in index
// space, so a store consuming a loaded VALUE does not count.
bool transitivelyFeedsStore(IndexTransformOpInterface op) {
  return walkDataflowGraph<WalkDirection::Consumers>(
             op.getOperation(),
             [](Operation *user) -> WalkResult {
               if (isa<StoreOp>(user))
                 return WalkResult::interrupt();
               if (isa<IndexTransformOpInterface>(user))
                 return WalkResult::advance();
               return WalkResult::skip();
             })
      .wasInterrupted();
}

// Length of the leading run of `chain` that does not feed a store. Feeding a
// store is monotonic toward the loop index, so the hoistable ops are a prefix.
size_t hoistablePrefixLen(ArrayRef<IndexTransformOpInterface> chain) {
  size_t n = 0;
  while (n < chain.size() && !transitivelyFeedsStore(chain[n]))
    ++n;
  return n;
}

// Hoists `chain` (feeding `loadOp`) into stride ops before `closure`, mapping
// capture block arguments through `outerValues` since the hoisted ops land
// outside the closure. Rewrites `loadOp` to read the new capture at the chain's
// outermost index. `DedupeCapturingClosureCaptures` folds duplicate captures
// later.
void hoistChain(LoadOp loadOp, ArrayRef<IndexTransformOpInterface> chain,
                OpBuilder &builder, CapturingFusionClosure closure,
                const IRMapping &outerValues) {
  Value outerTensor = outerValues.lookupOrDefault(loadOp.getTensor());

  Value tensor = outerTensor;
  for (IndexTransformOpInterface transform : chain)
    tensor = transform.createStridedView(builder, tensor, outerValues);
  BlockArgument newCaptureArg = closure.addCapture(tensor);

  IndexTransformOpInterface outermost = chain.back();
  loadOp.getTensorMutable().assign(newCaptureArg);
  loadOp.getIndexMutable().assign(outermost.getIndex());
}

// A fused elementwise producer shares its consumer's transformed index like a
// fused load; rewire it the same way, with nothing to hoist.
void rewireElementwiseIndices(Region &body) {
  // Only operands change, so rewiring in-walk is safe.
  body.walk([&](CallElementwiseOp call) {
    SmallVector<IndexTransformOpInterface> chain =
        collectIndexTransformChain(call.getIndex());
    size_t prefix = hoistablePrefixLen(chain);
    if (prefix == 0)
      return;
    // The loop index, or the result of the first store-index transform.
    call.getIndexMutable().assign(chain[prefix - 1].getIndex());
  });
}

LogicalResult loopInvariantViewMotionInClosure(CapturingFusionClosure closure) {
  Region &body = closure.getBody();
  OpBuilder builder(closure.getOperation());
  builder.setInsertionPoint(closure.getOperation());

  IRMapping outerValues;
  Block::BlockArgListType captureArgs = closure.getCaptureBlockArgs();
  ValueRange captures = closure.getCaptures();
  for (auto [arg, capture] : llvm::zip_equal(captureArgs, captures))
    outerValues.map(arg, capture);

  SmallVector<LoadOp> loads;
  body.walk([&](LoadOp op) { loads.push_back(op); });

  for (LoadOp loadOp : loads) {
    SmallVector<IndexTransformOpInterface> chain =
        collectIndexTransformChain(loadOp.getIndex());
    size_t prefix = hoistablePrefixLen(chain);
    if (prefix == 0)
      continue;
    chain.truncate(prefix);
    hoistChain(loadOp, chain, builder, closure, outerValues);
  }

  rewireElementwiseIndices(body);

  // Erase closest-to-load first so each outer hop is unused when reached.
  SmallVector<IndexTransformOpInterface> transforms;
  body.walk([&](IndexTransformOpInterface op) { transforms.push_back(op); });
  for (IndexTransformOpInterface transform : llvm::reverse(transforms))
    if (transform->use_empty())
      transform->erase();

  return success();
}

struct LoopInvariantViewMotionPass
    : public MAP::impl::LoopInvariantViewMotionBase<
          LoopInvariantViewMotionPass> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    MO::GraphOp graphOp = getOperation();

    // Walk, since a kernel can sit inside control flow (e.g. mo.while).
    WalkResult liftResult = graphOp.walk([&](CapturingFusionClosure closure) {
      if (failed(loopInvariantViewMotionInClosure(closure)))
        return WalkResult::interrupt();
      return WalkResult::advance();
    });
    if (liftResult.wasInterrupted())
      return signalPassFailure();

    // Invariant: only store-feeding index-transform ops remain.
    WalkResult invariant = graphOp.walk([&](IndexTransformOpInterface op) {
      if (transitivelyFeedsStore(op))
        return WalkResult::advance();
      op.emitError(
          "LoopInvariantViewMotion: an index-transform op survived hoisting "
          "-- this is a bug in the pass, not in the input IR");
      return WalkResult::interrupt();
    });
    if (invariant.wasInterrupted())
      signalPassFailure();
  }
};

} // namespace

} // namespace M::MAP

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
//
// Wraps structured MAP loops in `map.iter.opaque` regions so sequential setup
// can live outside the structured loop body.
//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Dialect/MAPOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MODevices.h"
#include "mlir/IR/Builders.h"

using namespace M;
using namespace mlir;

namespace M::MAP {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_OUTLINESTRUCTUREDKERNELBODIES
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h.inc"

namespace {

// Wraps `loop` in a `map.iter.opaque`, moving its body into the matching
// closure. Both are isolated from above, so the opaque's block args become the
// closure's `$captures`.
void outline(StructuredIterOpInterface loop) {
  auto kernel = cast<IterOpInterface>(loop.getOperation());
  Location loc = loop.getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(loop);

  auto opaque = IterOpaqueOp::create(builder, loc, loop->getResultTypes(),
                                     kernel.getInputs(), kernel.getInputChain(),
                                     /*fusionInfo=*/Attribute());
  // `map.iter.opaque` states its device explicitly; an unannotated loop runs
  // on the host, the `getDeviceOrDefault` fallback.
  opaque.setDeviceRef(MO::getDeviceOrDefault(
      cast<MO::MOHasDeviceInterface>(loop.getOperation())));
  if (Attribute fusionInfo = kernel.getFusionInfoAttr())
    opaque.setFusionInfoAttr(fusionInfo);
  opaque.setHasReadEffect(kernel.getHasReadEffect());
  opaque.setHasWriteEffect(kernel.getHasWriteEffect());
  opaque.setDispatch(kernel.getDispatch());

  // Chains get no block arg; the non-chain inputs and outputs are exactly the
  // closure's captures.
  Block *opaqueBody = builder.createBlock(&opaque.getBody());
  SmallVector<Value> bodyCaptures;
  for (Value input : kernel.getInputs())
    bodyCaptures.push_back(opaqueBody->addArgument(input.getType(), loc));
  for (Type resultType : loop->getResultTypes())
    if (!isa<MO::ChainType>(resultType))
      bodyCaptures.push_back(opaqueBody->addArgument(resultType, loc));

  builder.setInsertionPointToStart(opaqueBody);
  CapturingFusionClosure body =
      loop.createBodyClosure(builder, loc, bodyCaptures);

  // Move the body without cloning. The loop's block args are [inputs...,
  // outputs..., index] and the closure wants [index, captures...], so only
  // the index moves.
  BlockArgument oldIndexArg = loop.getIndexArg();
  Region &region = body.getBody();
  region.takeBody(loop->getRegion(0));
  Block &movedBody = region.front();
  BlockArgument newIndexArg =
      movedBody.insertArgument(0u, oldIndexArg.getType(), loc);
  oldIndexArg.replaceAllUsesWith(newIndexArg);
  movedBody.eraseArgument(movedBody.getNumArguments() - 1);

  loop->replaceAllUsesWith(opaque.getResults());
  loop->erase();
}

struct OutlineStructuredKernelBodiesPass
    : public MAP::impl::OutlineStructuredKernelBodiesBase<
          OutlineStructuredKernelBodiesPass> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    SmallVector<StructuredIterOpInterface> worklist;
    getOperation()->walk([&](StructuredIterOpInterface op) {
      worklist.push_back(op);
      return WalkResult::skip();
    });

    for (StructuredIterOpInterface op : worklist)
      outline(op);
  }
};

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_FUSEOUTPUT
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h.inc"

bool consumerReadsUntransformed(LoadOp load) {
  auto foreachOp = load->getParentOfType<IterElementwiseOp>();
  if (!foreachOp)
    return false;
  return load.getIndex() == foreachOp.getBody().front().getArguments().back();
}

bool consumerReadsThroughReshape(LoadOp load) {
  auto foreachOp = load->getParentOfType<IterElementwiseOp>();
  if (!foreachOp)
    return false;
  Value loopIdx = foreachOp.getBody().front().getArguments().back();
  auto reshape = load.getIndex().getDefiningOp<ReshapeIndexOp>();
  return reshape && reshape.getIndex() == loopIdx;
}

bool consumerIsPureReshape(LoadOp load) {
  if (!consumerReadsThroughReshape(load))
    return false;
  auto foreachOp = load->getParentOfType<IterElementwiseOp>();
  return llvm::all_of(
      getOutputStores(foreachOp.getBody().front()), [&](StoreOp store) {
        auto storedLoad = store.getValue().getDefiningOp<LoadOp>();
        return storedLoad && storedLoad.getTensor() == load.getTensor();
      });
}

namespace {

// One output-fusible edge: the consumer `src` reads `dst`'s `resultIdx` result
// (guarded by `epilogueOp`), either untransformed (`reshape` null) or through
// the single `reshape` of the loop index.
struct OutputFusionEdge {
  IterOpaqueOp dst;
  unsigned resultIdx;
  IterEpilogueOp epilogueOp;
  IterElementwiseOp src;
  ReshapeIndexOp reshape;
};

// Whether every use of `fusionArg` reads at the loop index.
bool readsAtLoopIndex(BlockArgument fusionArg, Value loopIdx) {
  for (Operation *user : fusionArg.getUsers()) {
    auto load = dyn_cast<LoadOp>(user);
    if (!load || load.getIndex() != loopIdx)
      return false;
  }
  return true;
}

// The single `map.index.reshape` of the loop index that every use of
// `fusionArg` loads through, or null if a use reads directly, through another
// transform, or through a different reshape.
ReshapeIndexOp reshapeOnFusedInput(Block &srcBody, BlockArgument fusionArg) {
  BlockArgument loopIdx = srcBody.getArguments().back();
  ReshapeIndexOp found = nullptr;
  for (Operation *user : fusionArg.getUsers()) {
    auto load = dyn_cast<LoadOp>(user);
    if (!load)
      return nullptr;
    auto reshape = load.getIndex().getDefiningOp<ReshapeIndexOp>();
    if (!reshape || reshape.getIndex() != loopIdx)
      return nullptr;
    if (found && found != reshape)
      return nullptr;
    found = reshape;
  }
  return found;
}

// The block arg of the single `src` input that reads `dstResult`.
BlockArgument fusedInputArg(IterElementwiseOp src, Value dstResult) {
  auto it = llvm::find(src.getInputs(), dstResult);
  return src.getBody().front().getArgument(it - src.getInputs().begin());
}

// The first load of `fusionArg` (all its uses are loads by the checks above).
LoadOp firstLoadOf(BlockArgument fusionArg) {
  for (Operation *user : fusionArg.getUsers())
    if (auto load = dyn_cast<LoadOp>(user))
      return load;
  return nullptr;
}

// The first output-fusible edge on `dst` that `config` accepts. Read-only.
std::optional<OutputFusionEdge>
findFusibleEdge(IterOpaqueOp dst, const OutputFusionConfig &config) {
  for (unsigned resultIdx = 0; resultIdx < dst.getNumNonChainResults();
       ++resultIdx) {
    Value res = dst->getResult(resultIdx);
    if (!res.hasOneUse())
      continue;
    IterEpilogueOp epilogueOp = dst.getEpilogueForResult(resultIdx);
    if (!epilogueOp)
      continue;
    Operation *user = res.getUses().begin()->getOwner();
    // Fusion stays within a block: never across a control-flow boundary.
    if (user->getBlock() != dst->getBlock())
      continue;
    auto src = dyn_cast<IterElementwiseOp>(user);
    if (!src)
      continue;
    // An epilogue already storing more than once serves several destinations
    // from one producer -- a consumer pair `FuseHorizontal` merged in, or a
    // result it kept for a reader of its own. Fusing rebuilds a single store,
    // so it cannot express that, whatever shape the consumer itself has.
    // TODO(GEX-4223): fuse into a multi-store epilogue by rebuilding only the
    // store the consumer reads.
    if (getOutputStores(epilogueOp.getBody().front()).size() != 1)
      continue;
    // A multi-output consumer needs a destination per output, which means
    // growing `dst`. Only all-destination-passing kernels qualify: a by-value
    // or chain result on either side carries ordering and yield constraints
    // this path does not model (`IterOpaqueOp::verify`).
    // TODO(GEX-4223): support multi-output consumers with by-value or chain
    // results.
    if (src.getNumResults() != 1) {
      if (llvm::any_of(src->getResultTypes(),
                       [](Type t) { return !isa<MO::TensorType>(t); }) ||
          llvm::any_of(dst->getResultTypes(),
                       [](Type t) { return !isa<MO::TensorType>(t); }) ||
          getOutputStores(src.getBody().front()).size() != src.getNumResults())
        continue;
    }
    if (llvm::count(src.getInputs(), res) != 1)
      continue;

    // A chain-returning consumer is `mo.mutable.store`, so the epilogue's
    // store is pointed at its buffer instead of `dst`'s own output.
    if (isa<MO::ChainType>(src.getResult(0).getType()) &&
        !isFusibleMutableStore(src, dst))
      continue;

    Block &srcBody = src.getBody().front();
    BlockArgument fusionArg = fusedInputArg(src, res);
    BlockArgument loopIdx = srcBody.getArguments().back();

    // Only a single reshape can be inverted onto the store (it preserves the
    // row-major offset).
    ReshapeIndexOp reshape = nullptr;
    if (!readsAtLoopIndex(fusionArg, loopIdx)) {
      reshape = reshapeOnFusedInput(srcBody, fusionArg);
      if (!reshape)
        continue;
    }

    // A `map.index.slice.select` in `src` moves into the epilogue whole (see
    // `fuseOutputOnce`), so it must hold at the epilogue's store index, which
    // a reshaped read would transform. The first store, rebuilt on `dst`'s own
    // result, must be a whole one.
    auto epilogueStore = getUniqueStore(epilogueOp.getBody().front());
    if (llvm::any_of(srcBody.getOps<SliceSelectOp>(),
                     [&](SliceSelectOp select) {
                       return reshape ||
                              failed(SliceSelectOp::verifySpecAt(
                                  select.getSpec(), epilogueStore.getIndex()));
                     }) ||
        getOutputStores(srcBody).front()->getBlock() != &srcBody)
      continue;

    // Reject if another operand transitively depends on `dst`: fusing would
    // create a cycle.
    if (llvm::any_of(src->getOperands(), [&](Value other) {
          return other != res && dataflowGraphDependsOn(other, dst);
        }))
      continue;

    if (config.shouldFuse(epilogueStore, firstLoadOf(fusionArg)))
      return OutputFusionEdge{dst, resultIdx, epilogueOp, src, reshape};
  }
  return std::nullopt;
}

} // namespace

IterOpaqueOp growOutputs(IterOpaqueOp dst, TypeRange extraTypes,
                         mlir::RewriterBase &rewriter) {
  if (extraTypes.empty())
    return dst;

  unsigned numDps = dst.getNumNonChainResults();
  SmallVector<Type> resultTypes(dst->getResultTypes());
  resultTypes.insert(resultTypes.begin() + numDps, extraTypes.begin(),
                     extraTypes.end());

  rewriter.setInsertionPoint(dst);
  auto newDst = IterOpaqueOp::create(
      rewriter, dst.getLoc(), resultTypes, dst.getInputs(), dst.getInputChain(),
      dst.getFusionInfoAttr(), dst.getHasReadEffect(), dst.getHasWriteEffect(),
      dst.getDispatch());
  // `device` and friends are discardable, so `create` does not carry them.
  newDst->setDiscardableAttrs(dst->getDiscardableAttrDictionary());
  newDst.getBody().takeBody(dst.getBody());

  Block &body = newDst.getBody().front();
  for (Type ty : extraTypes)
    body.addArgument(ty, dst.getLoc());

  for (auto [i, res] : llvm::enumerate(dst.getResults()))
    res.replaceAllUsesWith(
        newDst->getResult(i < numDps ? i : i + extraTypes.size()));
  rewriter.eraseOp(dst);
  return newDst;
}

namespace {

// Splices `src`'s per-element compute into `epilogueOp`. For a reshape read,
// the reshape is relocated onto the store index with in/out swapped, since the
// store direction is the inverse of the load.
IterOpaqueOp fuseOutputOnce(const OutputFusionEdge &edge,
                            PatternRewriter &rewriter) {
  IterOpaqueOp dst = edge.dst;
  IterEpilogueOp epilogueOp = edge.epilogueOp;
  IterElementwiseOp src = edge.src;
  ReshapeIndexOp reshape = edge.reshape;
  MLIRContext *ctx = dst.getContext();

  // `src`'s first output reuses the result `dst` already produces; the rest
  // need destinations of their own.
  SmallVector<Type> extraTypes(llvm::drop_begin(src->getResultTypes()));
  unsigned numDpsBefore = dst.getNumNonChainResults();
  dst = growOutputs(dst, extraTypes, rewriter);
  Value dstResult = dst->getResult(edge.resultIdx);
  Block &srcBody = src.getBody().front();
  Block &epilogueBody = epilogueOp.getBody().front();

  // May already reflect earlier fusions (e.g. a reshaped store index).
  auto epilogueStore = getUniqueStore(epilogueBody);
  Value val = epilogueStore.getValue();
  Value storeIdx = epilogueStore.getIndex();
  Value cap = epilogueStore.getTensor();
  Location storeLoc = epilogueStore.getLoc();

  Value storeTransform = storeIdx;
  if (reshape) {
    ViewSignatureAttr origSig = reshape.getSpec().getSignature();
    auto swappedSpec = ReshapeSpecAttr::get(
        ctx, ViewSignatureAttr::get(ctx, origSig.getOut(), origSig.getIn()));
    rewriter.setInsertionPoint(epilogueStore);
    storeTransform = ReshapeIndexOp::create(
        rewriter, storeLoc, IndexType::get(ctx, origSig.getOut().getRank()),
        swappedSpec, storeIdx);
  }

  auto fusionArgIt = llvm::find(src.getInputs(), dstResult);
  unsigned fusionArgIdx = fusionArgIt - src.getInputs().begin();
  BlockArgument fusionArg = srcBody.getArgument(fusionArgIdx);

  // `val` is the scalar `dst` produced for this element; it replaces every
  // load of the fused operand.
  for (Operation *user : llvm::to_vector(fusionArg.getUsers())) {
    auto load = cast<LoadOp>(user);
    load.getResult().replaceAllUsesWith(val);
    load.erase();
  }
  if (reshape)
    reshape.erase();

  // Every other input becomes a fresh epilogue capture, threaded through a new
  // shadowed input of `dst` (the epilogue is isolated from above).
  for (auto [i, input] : llvm::enumerate(src.getInputs())) {
    if (i == fusionArgIdx)
      continue;
    unsigned dstInputIdx = dst.getInputs().size();
    dst.insertInputsAt(dstInputIdx, input);
    Value dstInputArg = dst.getInputBlockArgs()[dstInputIdx];
    epilogueOp.getCapturesMutable().append(dstInputArg);
    BlockArgument capArg =
        epilogueBody.addArgument(input.getType(), input.getLoc());
    srcBody.getArgument(i).replaceAllUsesWith(capArg);
  }

  // The grown output block args are the extra stores' destinations. Read them
  // through the accessor: threading `src`'s inputs above shifted the args.
  SmallVector<Value> extraCaps;
  Block::BlockArgListType outArgs = dst.getOutputBlockArgs();
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < extraTypes.size(); ++i) {
    BlockArgument outArg = outArgs[numDpsBefore + i];
    epilogueOp.getCapturesMutable().append(outArg);
    extraCaps.push_back(
        epilogueBody.addArgument(outArg.getType(), outArg.getLoc()));
  }

  // The loop index is the body's last argument for both pointwise and
  // `mo.mutable.store` consumers; rewire it to the store index.
  SmallVector<StoreOp> srcStores = getOutputStores(srcBody);
  StoreOp srcStore = srcStores.front();
  Value finalVal = srcStore.getValue();
  // A store in a select keeps its place and its index, the select's argument;
  // only its destination moves to the new capture. The whole stores are
  // rebuilt at the store index below.
  SmallVector<std::pair<Value, Value>> extraStores;
  for (auto [store, extraCap] :
       llvm::zip_equal(llvm::drop_begin(srcStores), extraCaps)) {
    if (store->getBlock() != &srcBody)
      store.getTensorMutable().assign(extraCap);
    else
      extraStores.push_back({extraCap, store.getValue()});
  }
  // A `mo.mutable.store` consumer's buffer input is already an epilogue
  // capture; the store is rebuilt on it.
  Value storeTargetBuffer;
  if (isa<MO::ChainType>(src.getResult(0).getType()))
    storeTargetBuffer = srcStore.getTensor();
  for (StoreOp store : srcStores)
    if (store->getBlock() == &srcBody)
      store.erase();
  srcBody.getArguments().back().replaceAllUsesWith(storeTransform);
  srcBody.eraseArguments(0, srcBody.getNumArguments());

  // Retype the store-target path when the consumer changes the result's type.
  // For a reshape read the epilogue's RESULT keeps the producer's shape, which
  // the kernel (e.g. matmul) binds; the reshaped index reaches the destination.
  if (storeTargetBuffer) {
    cap = storeTargetBuffer;
    dst.setHasWriteEffect(true);
  }

  Type fusedTy = src.getResult(0).getType();
  if (!storeTargetBuffer && fusedTy != dstResult.getType()) {
    dstResult.setType(fusedTy);
    dst.getOutputBlockArgs()[edge.resultIdx].setType(fusedTy);
    cap.setType(fusedTy);
    if (!reshape)
      epilogueOp.getResult().setType(fusedTy);
  }

  epilogueStore.erase();
  rewriter.inlineBlockBefore(&srcBody, &epilogueBody, epilogueBody.end());
  rewriter.setInsertionPointToEnd(&epilogueBody);
  StoreOp::create(rewriter, storeLoc, cap, storeTransform, finalVal);
  for (auto [extraCap, extraVal] : extraStores)
    StoreOp::create(rewriter, storeLoc, extraCap, storeTransform, extraVal);

  // A `mo.mutable.store` consumer yields only an unused chain.
  if (!storeTargetBuffer) {
    SmallVector<Value> replacements{dstResult};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < extraTypes.size(); ++i)
      replacements.push_back(dst->getResult(numDpsBefore + i));
    src->replaceAllUsesWith(replacements);
  }
  return dst;
}

} // namespace

bool isFusibleMutableStore(IterElementwiseOp consumer, Operation *dst) {
  if (consumer.getNumResults() != 1 ||
      !isa<MO::ChainType>(consumer.getResult(0).getType()))
    return false;
  // A fused kernel must not write a buffer it also reads.
  if (llvm::any_of(consumer->getOperands(), [&](Value operand) {
        return isa<MO::BufferType>(operand.getType()) &&
               llvm::is_contained(dst->getOperands(), operand);
      }))
    return false;
  // `dst` holds no chain, so the store's chains must carry no ordering: its
  // input chain is fresh and nothing uses its output chain.
  // TODO(GEX-3964): give `dst` a chain in/out the way
  // `FuseMutableLoads::fuseLoadBufferAndChains` does, and fuse either way.
  Value inputChain = consumer.getInputChain();
  return (!inputChain ||
          isa_and_nonnull<MO::ChainCreateOp>(inputChain.getDefiningOp())) &&
         consumer.getResult(0).use_empty();
}

unsigned fuseOutput(MO::GraphOp graphOp, const OutputFusionConfig &config) {
  PatternRewriter rewriter(graphOp.getContext());

  // Kernels live in the graph body and in any nested control-flow regions (an
  // `mo.if`'s branches); a producer/consumer edge is always within one block.
  llvm::SmallSetVector<Block *, 8> blocks;
  graphOp.getBody().walk(
      [&](IterOpaqueOp op) { blocks.insert(op->getBlock()); });

  // Producers before consumers. Every block is sorted before anything fuses:
  // fusion erases the consumer and can rebuild the producer (`growOutputs`),
  // while the analysis holds a raw pointer to any op a nested block reads.
  MO::ParametricTopologyAnalysis topo(graphOp);
  SmallVector<SmallVector<Operation *>> sortedBlocks;
  for (Block *block : blocks) {
    SmallVector<Operation *> &ops = sortedBlocks.emplace_back();
    for (Operation &op : *block)
      ops.push_back(&op);
    topo.computeTopologicalSorting(ops);
  }

  DenseSet<Operation *> erased;
  unsigned numFused = 0;
  for (ArrayRef<Operation *> ops : sortedBlocks) {
    for (Operation *op : ops) {
      if (erased.contains(op))
        continue;
      auto dst = dyn_cast<IterOpaqueOp>(op);
      if (!dst)
        continue;
      while (std::optional<OutputFusionEdge> edge =
                 findFusibleEdge(dst, config)) {
        dst = fuseOutputOnce(*edge, rewriter);
        dst.setFusionInfoAttr(MOGG::createFusionInfo<MOGG::FusionEpilogueAttr>(
            dst.getContext(), {dst.getOperation(), edge->src.getOperation()},
            {static_cast<uint32_t>(edge->resultIdx)}));
        dst->setLoc(mlir::FusedLoc::get(dst.getContext(),
                                        {edge->src->getLoc(), dst->getLoc()}));
        erased.insert(edge->src);
        edge->src->erase();
        IterOpInterface(dst).dedupeInputs(rewriter);
        ++numFused;
      }
    }
  }
  return numFused;
}

namespace {

// Unconstrained output fusion (fuse every eligible edge). For testing.
struct FuseOutputPass : public MAP::impl::FuseOutputBase<FuseOutputPass> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    OutputFusionConfig config;
    config.shouldFuse = [](StoreOp, LoadOp) { return true; };
    fuseOutput(getOperation(), config);
  }
};

} // namespace

//
// Input-fusion wrapper for a sole-use `map.iter.elementwise` producer fusing
// into a `map.iter.opaque` consumer's existing prologue, so e.g. `gather(add(a,
// b), indices)` becomes one kernel whose data-operand prologue computes the add
// inline. A view producer is `ViewFuser`'s to claim first.
//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Dialect/MAPOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Support/InputFusion.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h"

#include "mlir/Support/LLVM.h"

using namespace M;

namespace M::MAP {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_FUSEPROLOGUE
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h.inc"

namespace {

struct FuseProloguePass : public MAP::impl::FusePrologueBase<FuseProloguePass> {
  using Base::Base;
  FuseProloguePass(const FuseProloguePass &other) : Base(other) {}

  void runOnOperation() override {
    InputFusionConfig config;
    // A foreach producer fusing into an opaque (the load lives in the opaque's
    // prologue; a foreach-body load would have no opaque parent here).
    config.shouldFuse = [](StoreOp srcStore, LoadOp dstLoad) {
      return srcStore->getParentOfType<IterElementwiseOp>() &&
             dstLoad->getParentOfType<IterOpaqueOp>();
    };
    // Only a sole-use producer fuses into a prologue.
    config.canDuplicate = [](IterElementwiseOp) { return false; };
    numKernelsFused = fuseInput(getOperation(), config);
  }

  Statistic numKernelsFused{this, "num-kernels-fused",
                            "Number of kernels fused"};
};

} // namespace

#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Dialect/MAPOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MODialect.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MOGGDialect/MOGGDialect.h"

#include "GraphCompiler/MOSHDialect/MOSHAttrs.h"

#include "mlir/IR/Builders.h"

using namespace M;
using namespace mlir;

namespace M::MAP {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_RAISEBACKCONTIGUOUSVIEWS
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h.inc"

namespace {

std::optional<int64_t> matchContiguousSliceDim(SliceIndexOp slice);

// Returns the index-transform chain of `op`'s body if that body is a pure view:
// a run of `map.index.slice`/`map.index.reshape` ops threading the loop index
// into a single load of the sole data input, feeding the store -- i.e. exactly
//   [t_1, ..., t_n, load, store]
// where `t_1` consumes the loop index, each `t_{i+1}` consumes `t_i`'s result
// (single-use), and `load` reads `t_n`'s result from input-0's block arg. The
// returned ops are in body order. Empty if the body is anything else, e.g. a
// compute kernel or a broadcast/transpose view. A chain arises when `ViewFuser`
// fuses adjacent views into one kernel.
SmallVector<Operation *> matchViewChain(IterElementwiseOp op) {
  SmallVector<Operation *> empty;
  if (op.getNumResults() != 1)
    return empty;
  Block &body = op.getBody().front();
  auto &ops = body.getOperations();

  SmallVector<Operation *> transforms;
  auto it = ops.begin();
  for (; it != ops.end() && isa<SliceIndexOp, ReshapeIndexOp>(&*it); ++it)
    transforms.push_back(&*it);
  if (transforms.empty())
    return empty;

  auto load = it != ops.end() ? dyn_cast<LoadOp>(&*it++) : nullptr;
  auto store = it != ops.end() ? dyn_cast<StoreOp>(&*it++) : nullptr;
  if (!load || !store || it != ops.end())
    return empty;

  // Each transform takes its index as operand 0.
  Value cursor = store.getIndex();
  for (Operation *t : transforms) {
    if (t->getOperand(0) != cursor || !t->getResult(0).hasOneUse())
      return empty;
    cursor = t->getResult(0);
  }
  if (load.getIndex() != cursor)
    return empty;
  if (load.getTensor() != body.getArgument(0))
    return empty;

  // Reshape is always raise-able; every slice must be contiguous.
  for (Operation *t : transforms)
    if (auto slice = dyn_cast<SliceIndexOp>(t))
      if (!matchContiguousSliceDim(slice))
        return empty;
  return transforms;
}

// The sliced dimension is the first input dim of size != 1, or the input rank
// if there is none.
int64_t findSliceDim(ArrayRef<int64_t> inDims) {
  for (auto [i, dim] : llvm::enumerate(inDims))
    if (dim != 1)
      return i;
  return inDims.size();
}

// Returns the sliced dimension `k` if `slice` is a contiguous slice: every
// dimension but `k` keeps its input's full extent, and `k`'s start/stop/step
// are static with step 1. A slice with any symbolic dim takes the general
// (already zero-copy) MAPToMOGG path instead.
std::optional<int64_t> matchContiguousSliceDim(SliceIndexOp slice) {
  MAP::SliceSpecAttr spec = slice.getSpec();
  SmallVector<int64_t> inDims = spec.getSignature().getIn().getIntDims();
  SmallVector<int64_t> outDims = spec.getSignature().getOut().getIntDims();
  if (llvm::any_of(inDims, ShapedType::isDynamic) ||
      llvm::any_of(outDims, ShapedType::isDynamic))
    return std::nullopt;

  int64_t k = findSliceDim(inDims);
  for (auto [i, inDim] : llvm::enumerate(inDims))
    if (static_cast<int64_t>(i) != k && inDim != outDims[i])
      return std::nullopt;

  ArrayRef<int64_t> starts = spec.getStarts().asArrayRef();
  ArrayRef<int64_t> stops = spec.getStops().asArrayRef();
  ArrayRef<int64_t> steps = spec.getSteps().asArrayRef();
  if (k == static_cast<int64_t>(inDims.size()) ||
      ShapedType::isDynamic(starts[k]) || ShapedType::isDynamic(stops[k]) ||
      steps[k] != 1)
    return std::nullopt;

  return k;
}

// Raises a `matchViewChain` kernel to standalone zero-copy ops: each slice
// becomes `mogg.slice` and each reshape `mo.static.reshape`.
//
// The body threads the loop index (output space) through the transforms into
// the input load, so the transforms run output->input; the data ops are their
// reverse (input->output). E.g. body `slice -> reshape -> load(in)` raises to
// `reshape(in) -> slice(...)` on the buffer.
bool raiseViewChain(IterElementwiseOp op, unsigned &numSlicesRaised,
                    unsigned &numReshapesRaised) {
  SmallVector<Operation *> chain = matchViewChain(op);
  if (chain.empty())
    return false;

  OpBuilder builder(op);
  Value cur = op.getInputs()[0];
  unsigned slicesHere = 0, reshapesHere = 0;
  for (Operation *t : llvm::reverse(chain)) {
    auto curType = cast<MO::TensorType>(cur.getType());
    // The last data op (first body transform) yields the kernel's result type.
    bool isLast = (t == chain.front());
    if (auto reshape = dyn_cast<ReshapeIndexOp>(t)) {
      Type outType = isLast ? op.getResultTypes()[0]
                            : Type(curType.cloneWith(
                                  reshape.getSpec().getSignature().getOut()));
      cur = MO::Static::ReshapeOp::create(builder, op.getLoc(),
                                          TypeRange{outType}, ValueRange{cur})
                ->getResult(0);
      ++reshapesHere;
    } else {
      auto slice = cast<SliceIndexOp>(t);
      MAP::SliceSpecAttr spec = slice.getSpec();
      int64_t k = *matchContiguousSliceDim(slice);
      ArrayRef<int64_t> starts = spec.getStarts().asArrayRef();
      ArrayRef<int64_t> stops = spec.getStops().asArrayRef();
      // The slice's start operand is a host tensor; reuse its device for the
      // scalar bound constants.
      auto hostDevice =
          cast<MO::TensorType>(slice->getOperand(1).getType()).getDeviceRef();
      Value startK =
          MO::ConstantOp::create(builder, op.getLoc(), starts[k], hostDevice);
      Value stopK =
          MO::ConstantOp::create(builder, op.getLoc(), stops[k], hostDevice);
      Type outType =
          isLast ? op.getResultTypes()[0]
                 : Type(curType.cloneWith(spec.getSignature().getOut()));
      cur = MOGG::SliceOp::create(builder, op.getLoc(), outType, cur, startK,
                                  stopK)
                ->getResult(0);
      ++slicesHere;
    }
  }
  op->replaceAllUsesWith(ValueRange{cur});
  op->erase();
  numSlicesRaised += slicesHere;
  numReshapesRaised += reshapesHere;
  return true;
}

struct RaiseBackContiguousViewsPass
    : public MAP::impl::RaiseBackContiguousViewsBase<
          RaiseBackContiguousViewsPass> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    MO::GraphOp graphOp = getOperation();
    // Walk, since a view kernel can sit inside control flow (e.g.
    // mo.parallel).
    unsigned slices = 0, reshapes = 0;
    SmallVector<IterElementwiseOp> foreachOps;
    graphOp.walk([&](IterElementwiseOp op) { foreachOps.push_back(op); });
    for (IterElementwiseOp op : foreachOps)
      raiseViewChain(op, slices, reshapes);
    numSlicesRaised = slices;
    numReshapesRaised = reshapes;
  }
};

} // namespace

bool isRaisableViewChain(IterElementwiseOp op) {
  return !matchViewChain(op).empty();
}

} // namespace M::MAP

//
// Fuses kernels into `map.iter.rowwise` reductions:
//
// - A producer only the rowwise reads is cloned at each load of its result.
// - A consumer over the per-row shape that reads a per-row result at its own
//   index becomes row-level ops; its result becomes a rowwise output, or, for
//   a `mo.mutable.store`, its store writes the buffer.
//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Dialect/MAPOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Support/InputFusion.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Support/OutputFusion.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MODevices.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MOGGDialect/MOGGAttrs.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MOGGDialect/Support/FusionUtils.h"

#include "mlir/IR/IRMapping.h"
#include "mlir/IR/PatternMatch.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/BitVector.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/STLExtras.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/SmallVector.h"

using namespace M;
using namespace mlir;

namespace M::MAP {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_FUSEREDUCTIONS
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h.inc"

namespace {

bool isPlainForeach(IterElementwiseOp op) {
  return op.getNumResults() == 1 && !op.getInputChain() && !op.getOutputChain();
}

bool sameDevice(IterElementwiseOp foreachOp, IterRowwiseOp rowwiseOp) {
  return MO::getDeviceOrDefault(
             cast<MO::MOHasDeviceInterface>(foreachOp.getOperation())) ==
         MO::getDeviceOrDefault(
             cast<MO::MOHasDeviceInterface>(rowwiseOp.getOperation()));
}

// Records `src` as fused into `dst`, in dataflow order: a producer before the
// rowwise, a consumer after it.
void stampFusion(IterRowwiseOp dst, IterElementwiseOp src, bool isProducer) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = dst->getContext();
  SmallVector<Operation *, 2> ops = {src, dst};
  if (!isProducer)
    std::swap(ops[0], ops[1]);
  dst.setFusionInfoAttr(
      MOGG::createFusionInfo<MOGG::FusionRowwiseAttr>(ctx, ops));
  dst->setLoc(FusedLoc::get(ctx, {ops[0]->getLoc(), ops[1]->getLoc()}));
  dst.setHasReadEffect(src.getHasReadEffect() || dst.getHasReadEffect());
  dst.setHasWriteEffect(src.getHasWriteEffect() || dst.getHasWriteEffect());
}

// TODO(GEX-3348): a producer other kernels also read stays materialized;
// duplicate it once shared reduction inputs are common.
bool canFuseProducer(IterRowwiseOp dst, IterElementwiseOp src) {
  if (!isPlainForeach(src) || src->getBlock() != dst->getBlock() ||
      !sameDevice(src, dst))
    return false;
  Value result = src.getResult(0);
  if (!llvm::all_of(result.getUsers(),
                    [&](Operation *user) { return user == dst; }))
    return false;
  // Reshape barrier, as in input fusion: a view cannot fuse into a load
  // already past a reshape.
  for (auto [input, arg] : llvm::zip(dst.getInputs(), dst.getInputBlockArgs()))
    if (input == result &&
        (!llvm::all_of(arg.getUsers(), llvm::IsaPred<LoadOp>) ||
         anyLoadCrossesReshape(arg)))
      return false;
  return true;
}

// Leaves `dst` with unique inputs, as `fuseConsumer` does.
void fuseProducer(IterRowwiseOp dst, IterElementwiseOp src,
                  RewriterBase &rewriter) {
  spliceProducer(dst, src, rewriter);
  stampFusion(dst, src, /*isProducer=*/true);
  IterOpInterface(dst).dedupeInputs(rewriter);
}

// The only store to output `outputIdx`, if it writes at the row index.
StoreOp perRowStore(IterRowwiseOp dst, unsigned outputIdx) {
  BlockArgument outputArg = dst.getOutputBlockArgs()[outputIdx];
  if (!outputArg.hasOneUse())
    return nullptr;
  auto store = dyn_cast<StoreOp>(*outputArg.getUsers().begin());
  if (!store || store->getParentOp() != dst ||
      store.getIndex() != dst.getRowArg())
    return nullptr;
  return store;
}

// Whether `shape` is `dst`'s shape with the reduced axis set to 1.
bool isPerRowShape(IterRowwiseOp dst, MOSH::ShapeAttr shape) {
  MOSH::ShapeAttr full = dst.getShape();
  int64_t axis = dst.getAxis();
  if (shape.getRank() != full.getRank() ||
      MOSH::ShapeAttr::getStaticDim(shape[axis]) != 1)
    return false;
  for (int64_t d = 0, e = full.getRank(); d < e; ++d)
    if (d != axis && shape[d] != full[d])
      return false;
  return true;
}

// Whether nothing between `dst` and `consumer` reads `dst`. Also rules out
// a cycle through another kernel.
bool canSinkTo(IterRowwiseOp dst, Operation *consumer) {
  for (Value result : dst.getResults())
    for (Operation *user : result.getUsers()) {
      Operation *top = dst->getBlock()->findAncestorOpInBlock(*user);
      if (top && top != consumer && top->isBeforeInBlock(consumer))
        return false;
    }
  return true;
}

// Whether one of `consumer`'s other inputs is defined after `dst`.
bool needsSink(IterRowwiseOp dst, IterElementwiseOp consumer) {
  return llvm::any_of(consumer.getInputs(), [&](Value input) {
    Operation *def = input.getDefiningOp();
    return def && def != dst && def->getBlock() == dst->getBlock() &&
           dst->isBeforeInBlock(def);
  });
}

bool canFuseConsumer(IterRowwiseOp dst, IterElementwiseOp consumer) {
  if (!(isPlainForeach(consumer) || isFusibleMutableStore(consumer, dst)) ||
      dst.getInputChain() || consumer->getBlock() != dst->getBlock() ||
      !sameDevice(consumer, dst) || !isPerRowShape(dst, consumer.getShape()))
    return false;

  Block &body = consumer.getBody().front();
  BlockArgument loopIdx = body.getArguments().back();
  for (auto [i, input] : llvm::enumerate(consumer.getInputs())) {
    auto result = dyn_cast<OpResult>(input);
    if (!result || result.getOwner() != dst)
      continue;
    if (!perRowStore(dst, result.getResultNumber()))
      return false;
    for (Operation *user : body.getArgument(i).getUsers()) {
      auto load = dyn_cast<LoadOp>(user);
      if (!load || load.getIndex() != loopIdx)
        return false;
    }
  }
  return !needsSink(dst, consumer) || canSinkTo(dst, consumer);
}

// Rebuilds `op` with the outputs in `kept` plus one per `extraTypes`. Dropped
// outputs must be unused.
IterRowwiseOp rebuildResults(IterRowwiseOp op, ArrayRef<unsigned> kept,
                             TypeRange extraTypes, RewriterBase &rewriter) {
  Value oldChain = op.getOutputChain();
  SmallVector<Type> types;
  for (unsigned idx : kept)
    types.push_back(op.getResult(idx).getType());
  llvm::append_range(types, extraTypes);
  if (oldChain)
    types.push_back(oldChain.getType());

  Block &body = op.getBody().front();
  unsigned numInputs = op.getInputs().size();
  unsigned numOutputs = op.getOutputBlockArgs().size();
  BitVector dropArgs(body.getNumArguments());
  for (unsigned idx = 0; idx < numOutputs; ++idx)
    if (!llvm::is_contained(kept, idx))
      dropArgs.set(numInputs + idx);
  body.eraseArguments(dropArgs);
  unsigned rowIdx = body.getNumArguments() - 1;
  for (Type type : extraTypes)
    body.insertArgument(rowIdx++, type, op.getLoc());

  rewriter.setInsertionPoint(op);
  auto newOp = IterRowwiseOp::create(
      rewriter, op.getLoc(), types, op->getOperands(), op.getProperties(),
      op->getDiscardableAttrDictionary().getValue());
  newOp.getBody().takeBody(op.getBody());
  for (auto [newIdx, oldIdx] : llvm::enumerate(kept))
    rewriter.replaceAllUsesWith(op.getResult(oldIdx), newOp.getResult(newIdx));
  if (oldChain)
    rewriter.replaceAllUsesWith(oldChain, newOp.getOutputChain());
  rewriter.eraseOp(op);
  return newOp;
}

IterRowwiseOp fuseConsumer(IterRowwiseOp dst, IterElementwiseOp consumer,
                           RewriterBase &rewriter) {
  if (needsSink(dst, consumer))
    dst->moveBefore(consumer);

  Block &consumerBody = consumer.getBody().front();
  IRMapping mapping;

  // Loads of a per-row result read the stored value instead.
  DenseMap<BlockArgument, Value> storedValues;
  SmallVector<unsigned> readResults;
  for (auto [i, input] : llvm::enumerate(consumer.getInputs())) {
    auto result = dyn_cast<OpResult>(input);
    BlockArgument arg = consumerBody.getArgument(i);
    if (result && result.getOwner() == dst) {
      storedValues[arg] = perRowStore(dst, result.getResultNumber()).getValue();
      readResults.push_back(result.getResultNumber());
      continue;
    }
    unsigned idx = dst.getInputs().size();
    dst.insertInputsAt(idx, input);
    mapping.map(arg, dst.getInputBlockArgs()[idx]);
  }

  // A `mo.mutable.store` stores into its buffer input, now one of `dst`'s, so
  // it adds no output; its chain has no use.
  Value consumerResult = consumer.getResult(0);
  bool storesToBuffer = isa<MO::ChainType>(consumerResult.getType());
  unsigned numOutputs = dst.getOutputBlockArgs().size();
  auto all = llvm::to_vector(llvm::seq<unsigned>(0, numOutputs));
  IterRowwiseOp newDst = rebuildResults(
      dst, all,
      storesToBuffer ? TypeRange{} : TypeRange{consumerResult.getType()},
      rewriter);
  mapping.map(consumerBody.getArguments().back(), newDst.getRowArg());
  if (!storesToBuffer)
    mapping.map(consumerBody.getArgument(consumer.getInputs().size()),
                newDst.getOutputBlockArgs().back());

  rewriter.setInsertionPointToEnd(&newDst.getBody().front());
  for (Operation &op : consumerBody) {
    if (auto load = dyn_cast<LoadOp>(op)) {
      auto arg = dyn_cast<BlockArgument>(load.getTensor());
      if (arg && storedValues.count(arg)) {
        mapping.map(load.getResult(), storedValues.lookup(arg));
        continue;
      }
    }
    rewriter.clone(op, mapping);
  }

  stampFusion(newDst, consumer, /*isProducer=*/false);
  if (storesToBuffer)
    newDst.setHasWriteEffect(true);
  else
    rewriter.replaceAllUsesWith(consumerResult, newDst.getResult(numOutputs));
  rewriter.eraseOp(consumer);
  IterOpInterface(newDst).dedupeInputs(rewriter);

  // Drop outputs only the consumer read.
  SmallVector<unsigned> kept;
  for (unsigned idx = 0, e = newDst.getOutputBlockArgs().size(); idx < e;
       ++idx) {
    if (!llvm::is_contained(readResults, idx) ||
        !newDst.getResult(idx).use_empty()) {
      kept.push_back(idx);
      continue;
    }
    rewriter.eraseOp(perRowStore(newDst, idx));
  }
  if (kept.size() == newDst.getOutputBlockArgs().size())
    return newDst;
  return rebuildResults(newDst, kept, TypeRange{}, rewriter);
}

IterElementwiseOp findProducer(IterRowwiseOp dst) {
  for (Value input : dst.getInputs())
    if (auto src = input.getDefiningOp<IterElementwiseOp>())
      if (canFuseProducer(dst, src))
        return src;
  return nullptr;
}

IterElementwiseOp findConsumer(IterRowwiseOp dst) {
  for (Value result : dst.getResults())
    for (Operation *user : result.getUsers())
      if (auto consumer = dyn_cast<IterElementwiseOp>(user))
        if (canFuseConsumer(dst, consumer))
          return consumer;
  return nullptr;
}

struct FuseReductionsPass
    : public MAP::impl::FuseReductionsBase<FuseReductionsPass> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    MO::GraphOp graphOp = getOperation();
    IRRewriter rewriter(graphOp.getContext());
    SmallVector<IterRowwiseOp> rowwiseOps;
    graphOp.getBody().walk([&](IterRowwiseOp op) {
      rowwiseOps.push_back(op);
      return WalkResult::skip();
    });

    for (IterRowwiseOp dst : rowwiseOps) {
      bool changed = true;
      while (changed) {
        changed = false;
        while (IterElementwiseOp src = findProducer(dst)) {
          fuseProducer(dst, src, rewriter);
          rewriter.eraseOp(src);
          ++numKernelsFused;
          changed = true;
        }
        if (IterElementwiseOp consumer = findConsumer(dst)) {
          dst = fuseConsumer(dst, consumer, rewriter);
          ++numKernelsFused;
          changed = true;
        }
      }
    }
  }
};

} // namespace

} // namespace M::MAP

//
// Output-fusion wrapper for a consumer that reads the producer's result through
// a single `map.index.reshape` of the loop index (and does more than relabel),
// collapsing e.g. `matmul -> reshape -> add` into one kernel by moving the
// reshape onto the epilogue's store index. An untransformed read is
// `EpilogueFuser`'s job; a bare reshape relabel is left as its own kernel.
//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Dialect/MAPOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Support/OutputFusion.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h"

using namespace M;

namespace M::MAP {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_FUSERESHAPEEPILOGUE
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h.inc"

namespace {

struct FuseReshapeEpiloguePass
    : public MAP::impl::FuseReshapeEpilogueBase<FuseReshapeEpiloguePass> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    OutputFusionConfig config;
    config.shouldFuse = [](StoreOp, LoadOp consumerLoad) {
      return consumerReadsThroughReshape(consumerLoad) &&
             !consumerIsPureReshape(consumerLoad);
    };
    fuseOutput(getOperation(), config);
  }
};

} // namespace

} // namespace M::MAP

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
//
// Input-fusion wrapper for a view producer (a foreach whose output flows from a
// transformed load) fusing into a consumer foreach body or an existing
// `map.iter.prologue` capture of a `map.iter.opaque`. A pure elementwise
// producer is `ElementwiseFuser`'s job.
//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Dialect/MAPOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Support/InputFusion.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h"

#include "mlir/Support/LLVM.h"

using namespace M;

namespace M::MAP {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_FUSEVIEWS
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Transforms/MAPTransforms.h.inc"

namespace {

struct FuseViewsPass : public MAP::impl::FuseViewsBase<FuseViewsPass> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    InputFusionConfig config;
    // The consumer is a foreach or an opaque, the only kinds input fusion
    // offers.
    config.shouldFuse = [](StoreOp srcStore, LoadOp) {
      return producesThroughView(srcStore);
    };
    // A pure view is a cheap index computation, always fine to re-derive per
    // consumer. A view already fused into elementwise compute is not: cloning
    // it re-reads all of its inputs, and on a residual chain
    // (h = h + reshape(matmul(h))) that recomputes every earlier layer in each
    // later one, so it is held to the elementwise duplication rule
    // (GEX-4234).
    config.canDuplicate = [](IterElementwiseOp src) {
      return isPureViewForeach(src) || isCheapToDuplicate(src);
    };
    numKernelsFused = fuseInput(getOperation(), config);
  }
};

} // namespace

} // namespace M::MAP

using namespace M;

namespace M::MOGG {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_JITCOMPILEKERNELS
#include "GraphCompiler/MOGGDialect/MOGGPasses.h.inc"

namespace {

struct JitCompileKernels
    : public impl::JitCompileKernelsBase<JitCompileKernels> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    ModuleOp module = getOperation();

    KGEN::CompilerTimeTraceScope traceScope("jit-compile-kernels",
                                            module->getName().getStringRef());

    initLLVM();

    if (compileMojoToBinary(module, kernelLibraryPaths).isError())
      signalPassFailure();
  }

  struct SemanticHashKey {
    using KeyTy = M::KGEN::GeneratorOp;

    static std::string hashKey(M::KGEN::GeneratorOp op) {
      return op->getAttrOfType<StringAttr>("semantic_hash").str();
    }
  };

  struct KGENCachingResult {
    SmallVector<StringAttr> cacheMissSymbols;
    SmallVector<std::string> cacheMissHashes;
    llvm::StringMap<std::pair<llvm::SmallVector<mlir::StringAttr>, BufferRef>>
        mojoCacheHits;
    RCRef<M::Cache::BlobCache<SemanticHashKey>> moggCache;
  };

  // Compilation state passed between functions to avoid too many arguments
  struct CompilationState {
    MLIRContext *ctx;
    ModuleOp mgpModule;
    OwningOpRef<ModuleOp> kgenModule;
    KGEN::ObjectCompiler *objectCompiler;
    KGEN::KGENCompiler *compiler;
    TargetInfoAttr targetInfo;
    AsyncRT::CPUDevice *cpuDevice;
    KGEN::CompilationOptions opts;
    OpBuilder builder;
    RCRef<Cache::TransformCache> mojoCache;

    CompilationState(MLIRContext *ctx, ModuleOp mgpModule,
                     OwningOpRef<ModuleOp> kgenModule,
                     KGEN::ObjectCompiler *objectCompiler,
                     KGEN::KGENCompiler *compiler, TargetInfoAttr targetInfo,
                     AsyncRT::CPUDevice *cpuDevice,
                     KGEN::CompilationOptions opts)
        : ctx(ctx), mgpModule(mgpModule), kgenModule(std::move(kgenModule)),
          objectCompiler(objectCompiler), compiler(compiler),
          targetInfo(targetInfo), cpuDevice(cpuDevice), opts(std::move(opts)),
          builder(ctx), mojoCache(objectCompiler->getTransformCache()) {}
  };

  // Collect unique kernel symbols from CompiledCallOp calls
  llvm::SetVector<StringAttr> collectRegionSymbols(ModuleOp mgpModuleOp) {
    llvm::SetVector<StringAttr> uniqueSymbols;
    for (auto &&modelOp : mgpModuleOp.getOps<MGP::ModelOp>()) {
      modelOp.walk([&](MOGG::CompiledCallOp callOp) {
        uniqueSymbols.insert(callOp.getCalleeSymbolAttr().getAttr());
      });
    }
    return uniqueSymbols;
  }

  SmallVector<StringAttr> collectStubSymbols(ModuleOp kgenModuleOp) {
    SmallVector<StringAttr> stubs;
    kgenModuleOp.walk<mlir::WalkOrder::PreOrder>(
        [&](KGEN::GeneratorOp generator) {
          // <input>:: is the prefix of all functions created by the GC because
          // there is no input file (all in-memory).
          if (generator.getSymName().contains("<input>::"))
            stubs.emplace_back(generator.getSymNameAttr());
          return mlir::WalkResult::skip();
        });

    return stubs;
  }

  // Rename region functions with semantic naming
  DenseMap<StringAttr, KGEN::GeneratorOp>
  renameGenerators(ModuleOp kgenModuleOp,
                   const llvm::SetVector<StringAttr> &uniqueSymbols) {
    auto symbolsToRename = llvm::map_to_vector(
        uniqueSymbols, [](StringAttr symbol) { return symbol; });
    return MOGG::applySemanticNaming(kgenModuleOp, symbolsToRename,
                                     SymbolTable(kgenModuleOp),
                                     /*namePrefix=*/"__kernel_");
  }

  // Update call sites and remove old CompiledLoadOp
  void updateMGPCallSites(
      ModuleOp mgpModuleOp,
      const DenseMap<StringAttr, KGEN::GeneratorOp> &renamedRegions) {
    for (auto &&modelOp : mgpModuleOp.getOps<MGP::ModelOp>()) {
      DenseSet<StringAttr> kernelsToLoadInThisModel;
      MOGG::CompiledLoadOp loadKernelsOp = nullptr;
      modelOp.walk([&](Operation *op) {
        if (auto callOp = dyn_cast<MOGG::CompiledCallOp>(op)) {
          auto oldName = callOp.getCalleeSymbolAttr().getAttr();
          auto it = renamedRegions.find(oldName);
          if (it != renamedRegions.end()) {
            auto genOp = it->second;
            auto newName = genOp.getSymNameAttr();
            callOp.setCalleeSymbol(newName);
            kernelsToLoadInThisModel.insert(newName);
          }
        } else if (auto loadCompiledKernelOp =
                       dyn_cast<MOGG::CompiledLoadOp>(op)) {
          ASSERT_STREAM(!loadKernelsOp,
                        << "Expected at most one CompiledLoadOp per ModelOp");
          loadKernelsOp = loadCompiledKernelOp;
        }
      });

      if (loadKernelsOp)
        loadKernelsOp.erase();
    }
  }

  // Build cache key from environment attributes
  CompileDiagnosticOr<std::string> buildCacheKey(ModuleOp kgenModuleOp) {
    WriteableBufferRef keyBufRef = WriteableBuffer::get();
    auto ctx = kgenModuleOp.getContext();

    auto *compileCtx = loadContext(ctx)->get<KGEN::CompilationContext>();
    KGEN::extendWithModularEnvAttr(kgenModuleOp, compileCtx);
    auto envAttr = KGEN::getModuleEnvAttr(kgenModuleOp);
    envAttr.printStripped(*keyBufRef);

    // Resolve the target as codegen does (honoring an accelerator override,
    // ignoring the virtual-CPU override for host execution); otherwise a
    // cross-compiled target could hit a host-warmed artifact, or a
    // host-compiled fold kernel could poison the cross target's key.
    auto hostTargetOr = MOGG::getHostTargetInfoAttr(
        ctx, defaultDeviceTargetArch, defaultDeviceTargetTriple,
        compileForHostExecution);
    if (hostTargetOr.isError())
      return kgenModuleOp->emitError() << hostTargetOr.takeError();
    if (auto error = MOGG::graphCompilerCacheKey(
            *keyBufRef, hostTargetOr.takeValue(),
            KernelBuildType::kRelease, // TODO: Support the other types.
            debugKGENStubs,
            "" // TODO: Consider removing this option.
        );
        error.isError()) {
      return kgenModuleOp->emitError() << error.takeError();
    }

    auto keyBuffer = keyBufRef->getBuffer();
    std::string envKeyHash =
        llvm::utohexstr(XXH3_64bits(keyBuffer.data(), keyBuffer.size()),
                        /*LowerCase=*/true,
                        /*Width=*/16);
    return envKeyHash;
  }

  // Check cache for each generator operation
  CompileDiagnosticOr<KGENCachingResult>
  checkCache(const CompilationState &state,
             const DenseMap<StringAttr, KGEN::GeneratorOp> &renaming,
             const std::string &keyHash) {
    MODULAR_CACHE_LOG("mogg") << "checkCache: keyHash=" << keyHash
                              << " kernelCount=" << renaming.size() << "\n";

    ErrorOr<RCRef<Cache::BlobCacheBackend>> moggCacheBackendOr =
        Cache::getLocalDefaultBackendChain(
            std::filesystem::path(".mogg_cache") / keyHash);
    if (moggCacheBackendOr.isError()) {
      MODULAR_CACHE_LOG("mogg")
          << "checkCache: failed to create MOGG cache backend: "
          << moggCacheBackendOr.getError() << "\n";
      return (*state.kgenModule)->emitError(moggCacheBackendOr.getError());
    }

    auto moggCache = RCRef<Cache::BlobCache<SemanticHashKey>>::create(
        moggCacheBackendOr.takeValue());

    // MOGG-cache hits, keyed by their blob (a mojo-cache key). A mojo-cache
    // miss demotes the op to a miss.
    llvm::StringMap<std::pair<llvm::SmallVector<mlir::StringAttr>, BufferRef>>
        mojoCacheHits;

    SmallVector<mlir::StringAttr> cacheMissSymbols;
    SmallVector<std::string> cacheMissHashes;
    DenseSet<KGEN::GeneratorOp> opsToErase;
    size_t moggHitCount = 0, moggMissCount = 0;
    size_t mojoHitCount = 0, mojoMissCount = 0;
    for (auto [oldName, genOp] : renaming) {
      auto genOpCopy = genOp;
      auto newName = genOpCopy.getSymNameAttr();
      std::string genOpHash;
      ErrorOr<std::optional<BufferRef>> moggCacheResult =
          moggCache->findSync(genOp, &genOpHash);
      if (moggCacheResult.isError()) {
        MODULAR_CACHE_LOG("mogg")
            << "checkCache: MOGG lookup error for " << newName.getValue()
            << ": " << moggCacheResult.getError() << "\n";
#ifndef MODULAR_PRODUCTION
        (*state.kgenModule)
            ->emitWarning(
                moggCacheResult.takeError()
                    .get()); // Swallow the error, because it's not critical
#endif
      }

      if (moggCacheResult->has_value()) {
        ++moggHitCount;
        BufferRef buffer = moggCacheResult->value();
        llvm::StringRef mojoCacheHashKey = buffer->getBuffer();

        ErrorOr<std::optional<BufferRef>> mojoCacheResultOr =
            state.mojoCache->findKeyedSync(mojoCacheHashKey);
        if (mojoCacheResultOr.isError() || !mojoCacheResultOr->has_value()) {
          ++mojoMissCount;
          MODULAR_CACHE_LOG("mogg") << "checkCache: MOGG hit but Mojo miss for "
                                    << newName.getValue() << "\n";
          cacheMissSymbols.push_back(newName);
          cacheMissHashes.push_back(genOpHash);
          if (mojoCacheResultOr.isError()) {
            MODULAR_CACHE_LOG("mogg")
                << "checkCache: Mojo lookup error for " << newName.getValue()
                << ": " << mojoCacheResultOr.getError() << "\n";
#ifndef MODULAR_PRODUCTION
            (*state.kgenModule)
                ->emitWarning(mojoCacheResultOr.takeError()
                                  .get()); // Swallow the error,
                                           // because it's not critical
#endif
          }
          continue;
        }
        ++mojoHitCount;
        std::optional<BufferRef> maybeMojoCachedItemBuffer =
            mojoCacheResultOr.takeValue();

        BufferRef mojoCachedItemBuffer = maybeMojoCachedItemBuffer.value();

        opsToErase.insert(genOp);
        auto [it, inserted] = mojoCacheHits.insert(
            {mojoCacheHashKey,
             {llvm::SmallVector<mlir::StringAttr>({newName}),
              std::move(mojoCachedItemBuffer)}});
        if (!inserted) {
          it->second.first.push_back(newName);
        }
      } else {
        ++moggMissCount;
        MODULAR_CACHE_LOG("mogg")
            << "checkCache: MOGG miss for " << newName.getValue() << "\n";
        cacheMissSymbols.push_back(newName);
        cacheMissHashes.push_back(genOpHash);
      }
    }

    MODULAR_CACHE_LOG("mogg")
        << "checkCache summary: " << renaming.size() << " kernels, "
        << "MOGG hit=" << moggHitCount << " miss=" << moggMissCount << ", "
        << "Mojo hit=" << mojoHitCount << " miss=" << mojoMissCount << "\n";

    // Erase operations after iteration to avoid use-after-free
    for (auto genOp : opsToErase)
      genOp.erase();

    KGENCachingResult result;
    result.cacheMissSymbols = std::move(cacheMissSymbols);
    result.cacheMissHashes = std::move(cacheMissHashes);
    result.mojoCacheHits = std::move(mojoCacheHits);
    result.moggCache = std::move(moggCache);

    return result;
  }

  CompileDiagnosticOr<KGENCachingResult>
  erasePreviouslyCompiledKernels(const CompilationState &state) {
    auto regionSymbols = collectRegionSymbols(state.mgpModule);
    // Stub symbols are excluded from semantic renaming: `ModuleHasher`
    // normalizes `FlatSymbolRefAttr`s, so stubs differing only in their
    // `FusionStruct_*` type would merge and `setInputsHash()` would collapse
    // their callers into wrong code. Stub dedup happens in
    // `MergeIdenticalFuncs`. Stub renaming can return once fusion stops
    // encoding identity in nominal struct symbols.

    llvm::SetVector<StringAttr> symbolsToRename(regionSymbols.begin(),
                                                regionSymbols.end());
    auto renamedRegions = renameGenerators(*state.kgenModule, symbolsToRename);

    updateMGPCallSites(state.mgpModule, renamedRegions);

    auto keyHashOr = buildCacheKey(*state.kgenModule);
    if (keyHashOr.isError())
      return keyHashOr.takeError();
    auto keyHash = keyHashOr.takeValue();

    return checkCache(state, renamedRegions, keyHash);
  }

  // Parse Mojo text from resources
  ErrorOr<OwningOpRef<ModuleOp>>
  parseMojoText(MLIRContext *ctx, ContextRef maxContext,
                const KGEN::CompilationOptions &opts) {
    auto resourceManager = DenseResourceElementsHandle::getManagerInterface(
        getOperation()->getContext());
    auto mojoTextResource = resourceManager.getBlobManager().lookup("mojo");
    if (!mojoTextResource)
      return OwningOpRef<ModuleOp>();

    auto mojoTextRef = mojoTextResource->getBlob()->getData();
    auto mojoText = StringRef(mojoTextRef.data(), mojoTextRef.size());

    auto mojoTextBuffer = llvm::MemoryBuffer::getMemBufferCopy(mojoText);
    llvm::SourceMgr src;
    src.AddNewSourceBuffer(std::move(mojoTextBuffer), llvm::SMLoc());

    KGEN::LIT::ParserConfig config(ctx, opts);
    mlir::TimingScope ts;
    auto parsedMojoModule =
        KGEN::LIT::importMojoFile(maxContext, src, config, ts);
    if (!parsedMojoModule)
      return Error("The GC could not parse the generated Mojo code");

    return parsedMojoModule;
  }

  // Setup compilation options
  KGEN::CompilationOptions
  setupCompilationOptions(TargetInfoAttr targetInfo,
                          ArrayRef<std::string> kernelLibraryPaths) {
    KGEN::CompilationOptions opts;
    // opts (not the module target-info stamp) drives the ObjectCompiler, so the
    // virtual-CPU override must reach it too or the cache key and codegen
    // desync. Gated, since propagating the host target unconditionally would
    // churn every JIT cache key; host-execution passes ignore the override.
    if (!compileForHostExecution && !M::Driver::getVirtualCpuTarget().empty()) {
      opts.targetTriple = targetInfo.getTripleStr();
      opts.targetCpu = targetInfo.getArch();
      opts.targetFeatures = targetInfo.getFeatures();
    }
    opts.targetAccelerator = targetInfo.getAcceleratorArch();
    for (const auto &libraryPath : kernelLibraryPaths) {
      opts.extraSearchPaths.push_back(
          std::filesystem::path(libraryPath).parent_path().string());
    }
    opts.saveTempsPrefix = saveTempPrefix.getValue();
    return opts;
  }

  // Extract and set bitcode libraries from packages
  void extractBitcodeLibs(MLIRContext *ctx, ModuleOp parsedMojoModule) {
    SmallVector<KGEN::LLVMBitcodeLibAttr> bitcodeLibAttrs;
    parsedMojoModule.walk([&](KGEN::LIT::PackageOp packageOp) {
      if (auto bitcodeModules = packageOp.getExternLLVMBitcodeModulesAttr()) {
        for (auto bitcodeAttr : bitcodeModules) {
          KGEN::LLVMBitcodeLibAttr libAttr =
              KGEN::LLVMBitcodeLibAttr::get(false, bitcodeAttr);
          bitcodeLibAttrs.push_back(libAttr);
        }
      }
    });
    if (!bitcodeLibAttrs.empty()) {
      KGEN::LLVMBitcodeLibArrayAttr arrayAttr =
          KGEN::LLVMBitcodeLibArrayAttr::get(ctx, bitcodeLibAttrs);
      parsedMojoModule->setAttr(
          KGEN::LLVMBitcodeLibArrayAttr::getBitcodeLibsAttrName(), arrayAttr);
    }
  }

  // Run LIT to KGEN pipeline
  CompileDiagnosticOrSuccess runLITToKGEN(KGEN::KGENCompiler &compiler,
                                          ModuleOp parsedMojoModule) {
    auto result = compiler.runGenerateLibraryPipeline(parsedMojoModule);
    if (result.isError()) {
      return parsedMojoModule.emitError(
                 "The graph compiler could not lower LIT to KGEN: ")
             << result.getError();
    }
    return success();
  }

  // Handle cache misses: elaborate and compile to LLVM
  CompileDiagnosticOrSuccess
  handleCacheMisses(CompilationState &state,
                    const KGENCachingResult &cachingResult) {
    // KGENToElaboratedKGEN
    if (state.compiler
            ->runElaborationPipeline(
                *state.kgenModule, state.targetInfo, *state.cpuDevice,
                state.cpuDevice->getReadyChain().copy(),
                Cache::CacheTelemetryContext::getTelemetryOnMissLambda(
                    "JitCompileKernels::elaborateKGEN",
                    "mogg.elaborate.kgen.cache.miss.time",
                    {{"pipeline", "JitCompileKernels::elaborateKGEN"}}),
                Cache::CacheTelemetryContext::getTelemetryOnHitLambda(
                    "JitCompileKernels::elaborateKGEN"))
            .isError()) {
      return (*state.kgenModule)
          ->emitError(
              "The graph compiler could not elaborate the generated KGEN");
    }

    // KGENToLLVM
    std::string outKeyHash;
    ErrorOr<BufferRef> bufferOr = state.objectCompiler->emitArchive(
        std::move(state.kgenModule), /*emitAssembly=*/false, &outKeyHash);
    if (bufferOr.isError()) {
      return state.mgpModule->emitError(
          "An error occurred while lowering KGEN to LLVM "
          "in the graph compiler");
    }
    BufferRef buffer = bufferOr.takeValue();
    DenseResourceElementsAttr archiveAttr =
        createArchiveAttr(state.ctx, std::move(buffer), outKeyHash);
    DenseResourceElementsHandle binaryBlobHandle = archiveAttr.getRawHandle();
    StringRef binaryBlobKey = binaryBlobHandle.getKey();
    binaryBlobKey.consume_front("archive_");
    for (const std::string &hash : cachingResult.cacheMissHashes) {
      BufferRef buffer = Buffer::get(binaryBlobKey);
      if (auto error = cachingResult.moggCache->insertKeyedSync(hash, buffer)) {
        MODULAR_CACHE_LOG("mogg")
            << "handleCacheMisses: MOGG cache insert failed for hash=" << hash
            << ": " << error.getError() << "\n";
#ifndef MODULAR_PRODUCTION
        state.mgpModule->emitWarning(
            error.takeError()
                .get()); // Swallow the error, because it's not critical
#endif
      } else {
        MODULAR_CACHE_LOG("mogg")
            << "handleCacheMisses: MOGG cache insert success for hash=" << hash
            << "\n";
      }
    }

    ArrayAttr symbolsAttr = mlir::ArrayAttr::get(
        state.ctx,
        llvm::to_vector_of<mlir::Attribute>(cachingResult.cacheMissSymbols));
    for (auto &&modelOp : state.mgpModule.getOps<MGP::ModelOp>()) {
      state.builder.setInsertionPointToStart(modelOp.getInitBlock());
      MOGG::CompiledLoadOp::create(
          state.builder, state.mgpModule->getLoc(), /*symbols=*/symbolsAttr,
          /*value=*/archiveAttr,
          /*debuginfo=*/debugKGENStubs ||
              hasDebuginfo(
                  KernelBuildType::kRelease // TODO: Support the other types.
                  ))
          ->setAttr("cache_miss", state.builder.getUnitAttr());
    }

    return success();
  }

  // Handle cache hits: load from cache
  void handleCacheHits(CompilationState &state,
                       const KGENCachingResult &cachingResult) {
    for (const auto &[blobHash, symbolsAndBufferPair] :
         cachingResult.mojoCacheHits) {
      ArrayAttr symbolsAttr = state.builder.getArrayAttr(
          llvm::to_vector_of<Attribute>(symbolsAndBufferPair.first));
      DenseResourceElementsAttr archiveAttr =
          createArchiveAttr(state.ctx, symbolsAndBufferPair.second, blobHash);
      for (auto &&modelOp : state.mgpModule.getOps<MGP::ModelOp>()) {
        state.builder.setInsertionPointToStart(modelOp.getInitBlock());
        MOGG::CompiledLoadOp::create(
            state.builder, state.mgpModule->getLoc(), /*symbols=*/symbolsAttr,
            /*value=*/archiveAttr,
            /*debuginfo=*/debugKGENStubs ||
                hasDebuginfo(
                    KernelBuildType::kRelease // TODO: Support the other types.
                    ))
            ->setAttr("cache_hit", state.builder.getUnitAttr());
      }
    }
  }

  CompileDiagnosticOrSuccess
  compileMojoToBinary(ModuleOp module,
                      ArrayRef<std::string> kernelLibraryPaths) {
    auto ctx = module.getContext();
    auto targetInfoAttr =
        getTargetInfo(ctx, defaultDeviceTargetArch, defaultDeviceTargetTriple,
                      compileForHostExecution);
    if (targetInfoAttr.isError()) {
      return module->emitError("Could not retrieve target info: ")
             << targetInfoAttr.getError();
    }

    ContextRef maxContext = loadContext(ctx);
    auto cpuDevice = maxContext->get<AsyncRT::CPUDevice>();

    auto targetInfo = targetInfoAttr.takeValue();
    auto opts = setupCompilationOptions(targetInfo, kernelLibraryPaths);

    auto parsedMojoModuleOr = parseMojoText(ctx, maxContext, opts);
    if (parsedMojoModuleOr.isError()) {
      return module->emitError(
          "The graph compiler could not parse its Mojo generated code");
    }
    auto parsedMojoModule = parsedMojoModuleOr.takeValue();
    if (!parsedMojoModule)
      return success();

    setTargetInfo(*parsedMojoModule, targetInfo);

    // Set the mojo defines (e.g., LOGGING_LEVEL) on the parsed Mojo module
    // so they're available during elaboration.
    auto *compileCtx = loadContext(ctx)->get<KGEN::CompilationContext>();
    KGEN::extendWithModularEnvAttr(*parsedMojoModule, compileCtx);

    extractBitcodeLibs(ctx, *parsedMojoModule);

    // LITToKGEN
    KGEN::KGENCompiler compiler(*ctx, opts);
    auto litResult = runLITToKGEN(compiler, *parsedMojoModule);
    if (litResult.isError())
      return litResult.takeError();

    MODULAR_CACHE_LOG("mogg")
        << "compileMojoToBinary: creating ObjectCompiler with "
           "basePath=" +
               KGEN::kMojoCacheBaseDirName + "\n";
    auto objectCompiler = KGEN::ObjectCompiler::create(
        KGEN::kMojoCacheBaseDirName, opts, /*isJit=*/true, *ctx, {});
    if (objectCompiler.isError()) {
      return module->emitError("The graph compiler could not create an "
                               "object compiler for KGEN to LLVM lowering");
    }

    CompilationState state(ctx, module, std::move(parsedMojoModule),
                           (*objectCompiler).get(), &compiler, targetInfo,
                           cpuDevice, opts);

    auto cachingResultOr = erasePreviouslyCompiledKernels(state);
    if (cachingResultOr.isError()) {
      return module->emitError("The graph compiler encountered an error while "
                               "caching previously compiled kernels");
    }
    auto cachingResult = cachingResultOr.takeValue();

    if (!cachingResult.cacheMissSymbols.empty()) {
      MODULAR_CACHE_LOG("mogg")
          << "compileMojoToBinary: compiling "
          << cachingResult.cacheMissSymbols.size() << " cache-miss kernels\n";
      auto cacheMissResult = handleCacheMisses(state, cachingResult);
      if (cacheMissResult.isError())
        return cacheMissResult.takeError();
    } else {
      MODULAR_CACHE_LOG("mogg")
          << "compileMojoToBinary: all kernels cached, no compilation "
             "needed\n";
    }

    handleCacheHits(state, cachingResult);

    return success();
  }
};

} // namespace

} // namespace M::MOGG
