mogg.kernel.decl @kernels.relu registration = "kernels.relu" device_info = <"", "", "", ""> struct_params = [] is_user_defined = false
mogg.kernel.decl @kernels.add registration = "kernels.add" device_info = <"", "", "", ""> struct_params = [] is_user_defined = false

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @drops_unused_input
// CHECK:       map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs ([[USED:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>)
// CHECK:         map.call.opaque @kernels.relu[] inputs([[USED]]) outputs
mo.graph @drops_unused_input(
  %used: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>,
  %unused: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32> {
  %y = map.iter.opaque inputs (%used : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>, %unused : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) outputs (%out : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) {
    map.call.opaque @kernels.relu[] inputs (%used) outputs (%out) kernelName = "kernels.relu" : (!mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) -> (!mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>)
  } {device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>}
  mo.output %y : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
}

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @dedupes_repeated_input
// CHECK:       map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs ([[A:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>)
// CHECK:         map.call.opaque @kernels.add[] inputs([[A]], [[A]]) outputs
mo.graph @dedupes_repeated_input(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32> {
  %y = map.iter.opaque inputs (%x as %a : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>, %x as %b : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) outputs (%out : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) {
    map.call.opaque @kernels.add[] inputs (%a, %b) outputs (%out) kernelName = "kernels.add" : (!mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) -> (!mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>)
  } {device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>}
  mo.output %y : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
}

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @keeps_prologue_captured_input
// CHECK:       map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs ([[X:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>)
mo.graph @keeps_prologue_captured_input(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32> {
  %y = map.iter.opaque inputs (%x : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) outputs (%out : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) {
    %pro = map.iter.prologue (%pidx : !map.index<3>) capturing {%pcap = %x : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>} {
      %pval = map.load %pcap[%pidx] : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
      map.yield %pval : f32
    } : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
    map.call.opaque @kernels.relu[] inputs (%pro) outputs (%out) kernelName = "kernels.relu" : (!mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) -> (!mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>)
  } {device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>}
  mo.output %y : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
}

// Capture dedup leaves the first load dead, and the canonicalizer's DCE
// erases it in the same fixed point -- only the yielded load survives.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @dedupes_prologue_captures
// CHECK:       map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs ([[A:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>)
// CHECK:         map.iter.prologue (%{{[^ :]+}} : !map.index<3>) capturing {[[CAP:%[^ =]+]] = [[A]] : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>} {
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[VAL:%[^ ]+]] = map.load [[CAP]]
// CHECK-NEXT:      map.yield [[VAL]]
mo.graph @dedupes_prologue_captures(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32> {
  %y = map.iter.opaque inputs (%x as %a : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) outputs (%out : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) {
    %pro = map.iter.prologue (%pidx : !map.index<3>) capturing {%pcap0 = %a : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>, %pcap1 = %a : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>} {
      %pval0 = map.load %pcap0[%pidx] : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
      %pval1 = map.load %pcap1[%pidx] : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
      map.yield %pval1 : f32
    } : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
    map.call.opaque @kernels.relu[] inputs (%pro) outputs (%out) kernelName = "kernels.relu" : (!mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) -> (!mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>)
  } {device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>}
  mo.output %y : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
}

// The duplicated captures sit behind the epilogue's leading value/index args.
// The duplicate is folded into one capture; its loads are dead after dedup
// and DCE'd. That leaves the surviving %a capture with no uses at all, so
// DropDeadCapturingClosureCaptures drops it too in the same fixed point --
// only the %out capture (still used by the store) survives.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @dedupes_epilogue_captures
// CHECK:       map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs ([[A:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:  outputs ([[O:%[^ :,]+]] : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>)
// CHECK:         map.iter.epilogue ([[VAL:%[^ :]+]] : f32, %{{[^ :]+}} : !map.index<3>) capturing {[[OCAP:%[^ =]+]] = [[O]] : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>} {
// CHECK-NEXT:      map.store [[OCAP]][%{{[^]]+}}] = [[VAL]]
mo.graph @dedupes_epilogue_captures(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32> {
  %y = map.iter.opaque inputs (%x as %a : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) outputs (%out : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) {
    %epi = map.iter.epilogue (%eval : f32, %eidx : !map.index<3>) capturing {%ecap = %out : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>, %ecap0 = %a : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>, %ecap1 = %a : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>} {
      %bias0 = map.load %ecap0[%eidx] : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
      %bias1 = map.load %ecap1[%eidx] : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
      map.store %ecap[%eidx] = %eval : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
    } : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
    map.call.opaque @kernels.relu[] inputs (%a) outputs (%epi) kernelName = "kernels.relu" : (!mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>) -> (!mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>)
  } {device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>}
  mo.output %y : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
}
GraphCompiler/test/mo-opt/MAPDialect/Transforms/AllocateAccumulatingBuffers/mixed-precision-matmul.mlir · complete source
// RUN: mo-opt %s --mogg-import-packages="mojo-pkg-paths=%kernel_api_test_lib" --mo-to-map --map-fuse-kernels --map-allocate-accumulating-buffers | FileCheck %s

// A dtype-changing cast fused into a matmul epilogue (mixed precision): the
// kernel accumulates in f32, the fused cast converts to si32 on the way out.
// `AllocateAccumulatingBuffers` adds a pre-cast (f32) scratch buffer as an extra
// kernel result and points the epilogue's `$intermediateTensor` at it, so the
// accumulation goes through f32 storage while the real output stays si32.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @matmul_cast
// The kernel gains a second (scratch, f32) output alongside the si32 output.
// CHECK: map.iter.opaque
// CHECK: outputs (%{{.*}} : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>, %{{.*}} : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>)
// The epilogue captures the si32 output but stores through the f32 scratch
// (its `intermediate` operand), and the store itself still writes the si32 value.
// CHECK: map.iter.epilogue
// CHECK-SAME: intermediate %{{.*}} : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
mo.graph @matmul_cast(
  %a: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>,
  %b: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32> {
  %mm = mo.matmul(%a, %b) : (!mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
  %c = mo.cast(%mm) : (!mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>
  mo.output %c : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>
}

// Two consumers of the matmul fuse horizontally and then into its epilogue, so
// the epilogue stores twice at two dtypes. The slice the kernel binds is built
// over `$intermediateTensor`, so it has to name the destination whose dtype the
// kernel actually hands in (f32) -- naming the si32 one points the kernel's
// accumulation at a narrower buffer and it writes past the end. A usable
// destination exists here, so no scratch result is added.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @matmul_add_and_cast
// CHECK: map.iter.opaque
// CHECK: outputs (%[[O0:.*]] : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>, %[[O1:.*]] : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>)
// CHECK-NOT: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>, %{{.*}} : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>)
// CHECK: map.iter.epilogue
// CHECK-SAME: intermediate %[[O0]] : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
// CHECK: map.store %{{.*}} : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
// CHECK: map.store %{{.*}} : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>
mo.graph @matmul_add_and_cast(
  %a: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>,
  %b: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>,
  %y: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
) -> (!mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>) {
  %mm = mo.matmul(%a, %b) : (!mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
  %s = mo.add(%mm, %y) : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
  %c = mo.cast(%mm) : (!mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>
  mo.output %s, %c : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>
}

// The same pair with the cast first, so the epilogue stores si32 before f32.
// The target is found by dtype, not store order: still the f32 destination,
// and still no scratch result.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @matmul_cast_and_add
// CHECK: map.iter.opaque
// CHECK: outputs (%[[O0:.*]] : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>, %[[O1:.*]] : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>)
// CHECK-NOT: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>, %{{.*}} : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>)
// CHECK: map.iter.epilogue
// CHECK-SAME: intermediate %[[O1]] : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
// CHECK: map.store %{{.*}} : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>
// CHECK: map.store %{{.*}} : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
mo.graph @matmul_cast_and_add(
  %a: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>,
  %b: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>,
  %y: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
) -> (!mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) {
  %mm = mo.matmul(%a, %b) : (!mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
  %c = mo.cast(%mm) : (!mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>
  %s = mo.add(%mm, %y) : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
  mo.output %c, %s : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
}

// RUN: mo-opt --mlir-print-local-scope %s --mogg-import-packages="mojo-pkg-paths=%kernel_api_test_pkg" --mo-to-map --map-fuse-elementwise | FileCheck %s

mo.graph @basic_add_mul(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>,
  %y: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>,
  %z: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
) -> !mo.tensor<[8], f32> {
  %tmp = mo.add(%x, %y) : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
  %out = mo.mul(%tmp, %z) : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
  mo.output %out : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
}

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @basic_add_mul
// CHECK-SAME:  (%[[X:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, %[[Y:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, %[[Z:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:  %[[OUT:.*]] = map.iter.elementwise<[8]>
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs (%[[X]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, %[[Y]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, %[[Z]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>)
// CHECK:       %[[XV:.*]] = map.load %[[X]][%{{.*}}] : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:  %[[YV:.*]] = map.load %[[Y]][%{{.*}}] : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:  %[[ADD:.*]] = map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Add(%{{.*}}, %[[XV]], %[[YV]])
// CHECK-NEXT:  %[[ZV:.*]] = map.load %[[Z]][%{{.*}}] : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:  map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Mul(%{{.*}}, %[[ADD]], %[[ZV]])
// CHECK-NEXT:  map.store
// CHECK:       fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_elementwise<[#mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.add"{{.*}}, #mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.mul"{{.*}}]>>
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.elementwise

mo.graph @add_mul_duplicate_operands(

) -> !mo.tensor<[8], f32> {
  %t0 = mo.add(%x, %x) : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
  %t1 = mo.mul(%t0, %x) : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
  %out = mo.add(%x, %t1) : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
  mo.output %out : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
}

// Duplicate %x operand slots are uniqued after fusion; %x is a single input.

// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs (%[[X]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>)
// CHECK:       %[[V1:.*]] = map.load %[[X]][%{{.*}}] : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>

// CHECK:       fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_elementwise<[#mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.add"{{.*}}, #mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.mul"{{.*}}, #mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.add"{{.*}}]>>
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.elementwise

mo.graph @fusion_diamond(

GraphCompiler/test/mo-opt/MAPDialect/Transforms/ElementwiseFusion/large_operand_dup.mlir · complete source
// RUN: mo-opt %s --mogg-import-packages --mo-to-map --map-fuse-elementwise | FileCheck %s
// RUN: mo-opt %s --mogg-import-packages --mo-to-map --map-fuse-elementwise=large-tensor-element-threshold=16384 | FileCheck %s --check-prefix=HIGHTHRESH

// A multi-use binary op over TWO large operands must NOT be duplicated: the Add
// is materialized into its own kernel and each consumer reads its result.
mo.graph @binaryAddLargeFanout(%arg0: !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>, %arg1: !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>) -> (!mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>, !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>) {
  %0 = mo.add(%arg0, %arg1) : !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>
  %1 = mo.tanh(%0) : !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>
  %2 = mo.relu(%0) : !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>
  mo.output %1, %2 : !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>, !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>
}

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @binaryAddLargeFanout
// CHECK: %[[ADD:.*]] = map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK: map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Add
// CHECK-NOT: map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Add
// CHECK: map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK: inputs (%[[ADD]]
// CHECK: map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Tanh
// CHECK: map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK: inputs (%[[ADD]]
// CHECK: map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.ReLU

// With `large-tensor-element-threshold` raised above the operands' 8192-element
// count, both operands count as small, so the Add is cloned into each
// consumer's fused kernel instead of being materialized once.
// HIGHTHRESH-LABEL: mo.graph @binaryAddLargeFanout
// HIGHTHRESH: map.iter.elementwise
// HIGHTHRESH: map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Add
// HIGHTHRESH: map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Tanh
// HIGHTHRESH: map.iter.elementwise
// HIGHTHRESH: map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Add
// HIGHTHRESH: map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.ReLU

// A multi-use UNARY op has at most one large operand, so re-reading it on
// duplication is not a net loss. It is still cloned into each consumer's fused
// subgraph (Exp appears in both kernels), preserving the existing fusion win.
mo.graph @unaryExpLargeFanout(%arg0: !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>) -> (!mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>, !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>) {
  %0 = mo.exp(%arg0) : !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>
  %1 = mo.tanh(%0) : !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>
  %2 = mo.relu(%0) : !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>
  mo.output %1, %2 : !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>, !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>
}

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @unaryExpLargeFanout
// CHECK: map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK: map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Exp
// CHECK: map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Tanh
// CHECK: map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK: map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Exp
// CHECK: map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.ReLU

// The same unary op, but its result is also a graph output: it is written to
// memory either way, so cloning it into the consumer only adds work.
mo.graph @unaryExpEscapingOutput(%arg0: !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>) -> (!mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>, !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>) {
  %0 = mo.exp(%arg0) : !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>
  %1 = mo.tanh(%0) : !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>
  mo.output %0, %1 : !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>, !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>
}

  mo.output %1, %2 : !mo.tensor<[4096, 8], f32, gpu:0>, !mo.tensor<[4096, 2], f32, gpu:0>
}

// (a pre-cast scratch buffer); this test is fusion-only, so no scratch appears.

mo.graph @fuse_matmul_cast(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>,
  %y: !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>
) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 8], si32> {
  %mm = mo.matmul(%x, %y) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>
  %out = mo.cast(%mm) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 8], si32>
  mo.output %out : !mo.tensor<[8, 8], si32>
}

GraphCompiler/test/mo-opt/MAPDialect/Transforms/HorizontalFusion/horizontal_fusion.mlir · complete source
// RUN: mo-opt %s --mogg-import-packages --mo-to-map --map-fuse-horizontal | FileCheck %s
// RUN: mo-opt %s --mogg-import-packages --mo-to-map --map-fuse-horizontal --mlir-print-debuginfo --mlir-print-local-scope | FileCheck %s --check-prefix=LOC

// Two adds over the same index space sharing %x fuse into one kernel with two
// stores. The duplicate load of %x survives in isolation because the CSE that
// collapses it runs in `FuseKernels`, not in this pass.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @shared_operand
// CHECK-SAME:  (%[[X:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, %[[Y:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, %[[Z:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:  %[[OUT:.*]]:2 = map.iter.elementwise<[8]>
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs (%[[X]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, %[[Y]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, %[[Z]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:  outputs (%[[O0:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, %[[O1:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>)
// CHECK:       map.store %[[O0]]
// CHECK:       map.store %[[O1]]
// CHECK:       mo.output %[[OUT]]#0, %[[OUT]]#1
mo.graph @shared_operand(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>,
  %y: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>,
  %z: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
) -> (!mo.tensor<[8], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8], f32>) {
  %a = mo.add(%x, %y) : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
  %b = mo.add(%x, %z) : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
  mo.output %a, %b : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
}

// Sharing an operand is the whole trigger, so disjoint inputs stay apart.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @no_shared_operand
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.elementwise<[8]>{{.*}}:2
// CHECK:       map.iter.elementwise<[8]>
// CHECK:       map.iter.elementwise<[8]>
mo.graph @no_shared_operand(
  %w: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>,
  %x: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>,
  %y: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>,
  %z: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
) -> (!mo.tensor<[8], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8], f32>) {
  %a = mo.add(%w, %x) : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
  %b = mo.add(%y, %z) : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
  mo.output %a, %b : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
}

// Siblings need not agree on output dtype: each store keeps its own.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @add_and_cast_share_operand
// CHECK:       %[[OUT:.*]]:2 = map.iter.elementwise<[8]>
// CHECK:       outputs (%[[O0:[a-z0-9]+]]: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, %[[O1:[a-z0-9]+]]: !mo.tensor<[8], si32>)
// CHECK:       map.store %[[O0]][%{{.*}}] = %{{.*}} : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
// CHECK:       %[[CAST:.*]] = map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Cast(%{{.*}}) : !map.index<1>, f32 -> si32
// CHECK-NEXT:  map.store %[[O1]][%{{.*}}] = %[[CAST]] : !mo.tensor<[8], si32>
// CHECK:       mo.output %[[OUT]]#0, %[[OUT]]#1
mo.graph @add_and_cast_share_operand(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>,
  %y: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
) -> (!mo.tensor<[8], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8], si32>) {
  %a = mo.add(%x, %y) : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
  %c = mo.cast(%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8], si32>
  mo.output %a, %c : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8], si32>
}

// A parametric extent: the pair is matched on the dim parameter, not a
// constant, so the fused kernel iterates `[n]` and both stores land in it.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @two_adds_dynamic<n>
// CHECK:       %[[OUT:.*]]:2 = map.iter.elementwise<[n]>
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs (%{{.*}}: !mo.tensor<[n], f32>, %{{.*}}: !mo.tensor<[n], f32>, %{{.*}}: !mo.tensor<[n], f32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:  outputs (%[[O0:[a-z0-9]+]]: !mo.tensor<[n], f32>, %[[O1:[a-z0-9]+]]: !mo.tensor<[n], f32>)
// CHECK:       map.store %[[O0]]
// CHECK:       map.store %[[O1]]
// CHECK:       mo.output %[[OUT]]#0, %[[OUT]]#1
mo.graph @two_adds_dynamic<n>(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[n], f32>,
  %y: !mo.tensor<[n], f32>,
  %z: !mo.tensor<[n], f32>
) -> (!mo.tensor<[n], f32>, !mo.tensor<[n], f32>) {
  %a = mo.add(%x, %y) : !mo.tensor<[n], f32>
  %b = mo.add(%x, %z) : !mo.tensor<[n], f32>
  mo.output %a, %b : !mo.tensor<[n], f32>, !mo.tensor<[n], f32>
}

// A reader between the two kernels blocks the pair, and it counts even when it
// sits inside a region: the fused kernel would be built at the second one's
// position, leaving the `mo.if` above it consuming a result produced below --
// a cycle. Tight captures here matter: a fused pair prints as `%N:2 =`, which
// these patterns cannot match.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @reader_inside_branch
// CHECK:       %[[A:[a-z0-9]+]] = map.iter.elementwise<[4]>
// CHECK:       %[[IF:[a-z0-9]+]] = mo.if
// CHECK:       map.iter.elementwise<[4]>
// CHECK:       %[[B:[a-z0-9]+]] = map.iter.elementwise<[4]>
// CHECK:       mo.output %[[B]], %[[IF]]
mo.graph @reader_inside_branch(
  %cond: !mo.tensor<[], bool>,
  %a: !mo.tensor<[4], f32>,
  %b: !mo.tensor<[4], f32>,
  %c: !mo.tensor<[4], f32>,
  %d: !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
) -> (!mo.tensor<[4], f32>, !mo.tensor<[4], f32>) {
  %x = mo.add(%a, %b) : !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
  %t = mo.if (%cond : !mo.tensor<[], bool>) -> !mo.tensor<[4], f32> {
    %m = mo.mul(%x, %c) : !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
    mo.yield %m : !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
  } else {
    mo.yield %c : !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
  }
  %y = mo.add(%a, %d) : !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
  mo.output %y, %t : !mo.tensor<[4], f32>, !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
}

// The merged kernel launches async if either member does, as input fusion
// combines the launch policy (a transpose launches sync), keeps the discardable
// attributes of both, and fuses their locations.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @merge_launch_attrs_and_locs
// CHECK:       %[[OUT:.*]]:2 = map.iter.elementwise<[8]>
// CHECK:       } {fusionInfo = {{.*}}, hasReadEffect = false, hasWriteEffect = false, test.only_b}
// CHECK-NEXT:  mo.output %[[OUT]]#0, %[[OUT]]#1
// LOC-LABEL:   mo.graph @merge_launch_attrs_and_locs
// LOC:         test.only_b} loc(fused["a", "b"])
mo.graph @merge_launch_attrs_and_locs(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
) -> (!mo.tensor<[8], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8], f32>) {
  %a = map.iter.elementwise<[8]> inputs (%x: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>) outputs (%out: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>) index (%idx: !map.index<1>) -> !mo.tensor<[8], f32> {
    %v = map.load %x[%idx] : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
    map.store %out[%idx] = %v : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
  } {dispatch = #mogg.dispatch<immediate>} loc("a")
  %b = map.iter.elementwise<[8]> inputs (%x: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>) outputs (%out: !mo.tensor<[8], f32>) index (%idx: !map.index<1>) -> !mo.tensor<[8], f32> {
    %v = map.load %x[%idx] : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
    map.store %out[%idx] = %v : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
  } {test.only_b} loc("b")
  mo.output %a, %b : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
}

// Two slices of one tensor share their loaded input, but each is a pure view
// that `RaiseBackContiguousViews` turns into a zero-copy view. Merged, they
// would be a kernel copying both windows, so they stay apart.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @two_views_of_one_tensor
// CHECK:       map.iter.elementwise<[4, 64]>
// CHECK-NOT:   map.store
// CHECK:       map.store
// CHECK-NOT:   map.store
// CHECK:       map.iter.elementwise<[4, 64]>
// CHECK-NOT:   map.store
// CHECK:       map.store
// CHECK-NOT:   map.store
// CHECK:       mo.output
mo.graph @two_views_of_one_tensor(%w: !mo.tensor<[8, 64], f32>) -> (!mo.tensor<[4, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[4, 64], f32>) {
  %start0 = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<0, 0> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %stop0 = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<4, 64> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %start1 = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<4, 0> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %stop1 = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<8, 64> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %step = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<1, 1> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %v0 = mo.slice(%w, %start0, %stop0, %step) : (
    !mo.tensor<[8, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  ) -> !mo.tensor<[4, 64], f32>
  %v1 = mo.slice(%w, %start1, %stop1, %step) : (
    !mo.tensor<[8, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  ) -> !mo.tensor<[4, 64], f32>
  mo.output %v0, %v1 : !mo.tensor<[4, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[4, 64], f32>
}
GraphCompiler/test/mo-opt/MAPDialect/Transforms/LoopInvariantViewMotion/loop-invariant-view-motion-broadcast-atop-store-reshape.mlir · complete source
// RUN: mo-opt %s --pass-pipeline='builtin.module(mo.graph(map-livm, map.iter.opaque(canonicalize,cse)))' | FileCheck %s

// A load-side view (broadcast) whose index is computed THROUGH a store-index
// reshape -- the shape a reshape-into-epilogue fuses (the bias load of
// `reshape(matmul) + broadcast(c)` reads at the reshaped store index). The
// broadcast feeds only its load, so it hoists into a map.index.broadcast.stride
// view read at the reshaped index; the reshape feeds the store and stays in the
// loop. Before the per-op "does it transitively feed a store" rule, LoopInvariant
// ViewMotion bailed on the whole chain and left the un-lowerable broadcast
// behind, erroring "an index-transform op survived hoisting".

module {

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @broadcastAtopStoreReshape
// CHECK:         map.iter.opaque
// CHECK:         inputs ([[IN:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[1], f32>)
// CHECK:         outputs ([[OUT:%[^ :,]+]] : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>) {
// The broadcast hoists to a loop-invariant stride view of the input.
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[BS:%[^ ]+]] = map.index.broadcast.stride<#map.index.broadcast.spec<[1] -> [8]>> ([[IN]])
// CHECK-NEXT:      map.iter.elementwise.body<[2, 4]>
// CHECK-NEXT:        index   ([[IDX:%[^ :,]+]]: !map.index<2>)
// CHECK-NEXT:        capturing {{{.*}}[[BCAP:%[^ ]+]] = [[BS]] : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>} {
// The reshape stays in the loop (it feeds the store); the load reads the hoisted
// broadcast view at the reshaped index. No load-side broadcast survives.
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[R:%[^ ]+]] = map.index.reshape<#map.index.reshape.spec<[8] -> [2, 4]>> ([[IDX]])
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[VAL:%[^ ]+]] = map.load [[BCAP]]{{\[}}[[R]]] : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:      map.store {{%[^ ]+}}{{\[}}[[R]]] = [[VAL]] : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
// CHECK-NOT:       map.index.broadcast<
mo.graph @broadcastAtopStoreReshape(%c: !mo.tensor<[1], f32>)
    -> !mo.tensor<[8], f32> {
  %output = map.iter.opaque
      inputs (%c : !mo.tensor<[1], f32>)
      outputs (%out : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>) {
    map.iter.elementwise.body<[2, 4]>
        index (%idx: !map.index<2>)
        capturing {%c0 = %c : !mo.tensor<[1], f32>, %out0 = %out : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>} {
      %r = map.index.reshape<#map.index.reshape.spec<[8] -> [2, 4]>> (%idx)
          : !map.index<2> -> !map.index<1>
      %b = map.index.broadcast<#map.index.broadcast.spec<[1] -> [8]>> (%r)
          : !map.index<1> -> !map.index<1>
      %v = map.load %c0[%b] : !mo.tensor<[1], f32>
      map.store %out0[%r] = %v : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
    }
  } {device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>}
  mo.output %output : !mo.tensor<[8], f32>
}

}
GraphCompiler/test/mo-opt/MAPDialect/Transforms/LoopInvariantViewMotion/loop-invariant-view-motion-transpose.mlir · complete source
// RUN: mo-opt %s --pass-pipeline='builtin.module(mo.graph(map-livm, map.iter.opaque(canonicalize,cse)))' | FileCheck %s

// LoopInvariantViewMotion hoists a map.index.transpose chain feeding a
// map.load out of the loop body into a map.index.transpose.stride op in the
// enclosing map.iter.opaque, rewriting the load to use the loop's own
// (untransformed) index directly -- same generic IndexTransformOpInterface
// mechanism already exercised by map.index.slice/map.index.broadcast, no
// pass changes needed. The transpose's perm operand rides along into the
// hoisted stride op (like slice's bounds), and canonicalize then drops the
// now-dead original input capture.

module {

// 2D swap: out.dim[0] = in.dim[1], out.dim[1] = in.dim[0].

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @transposeSwap
// CHECK:         [[RESULT:%[^ ]+]] = map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:    inputs ([[INPUT:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[2, 3], f32>, [[PERM:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[2], si64>)
// CHECK-NEXT:    outputs ([[OUT:%[^ :,]+]] : !mo.tensor<[3, 2], f32>) {
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[STRIDED:%[^ ]+]] = map.index.transpose.stride<#map.index.transpose.spec<[2, 3] -> [3, 2], perm = [1, 0]>> ([[INPUT]], [[PERM]])
// CHECK-NEXT:      map.iter.elementwise.body<[3, 2]>
// CHECK-NEXT:        index   ([[IDX:%[^ :,]+]]: !map.index<2>)
// CHECK-NEXT:        capturing {{{.*}}[[OUT0:%[^ ,]+]] = [[OUT]] : !mo.tensor<[3, 2], f32>, [[NEWCAP:%[^ ]+]] = [[STRIDED]] : !mo.tensor<[3, 2], f32>} {
// CHECK-NOT:       map.index.transpose
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[VAL:%[^ ]+]] = map.load [[NEWCAP]]{{\[}}[[IDX]]] : !mo.tensor<[3, 2], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:      map.store [[OUT0]]{{\[}}[[IDX]]] = [[VAL]] : !mo.tensor<[3, 2], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:    }
mo.graph @transposeSwap(%input: !mo.tensor<[2, 3], f32>, %perm: !mo.tensor<[2], si64>)
    -> !mo.tensor<[3, 2], f32> {
  %output = map.iter.opaque
      inputs (%input : !mo.tensor<[2, 3], f32>, %perm : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>)
      outputs (%out : !mo.tensor<[3, 2], f32>) {
    map.iter.elementwise.body<[3, 2]>
        index (%idx: !map.index<2>)
        capturing {%input0 = %input : !mo.tensor<[2, 3], f32>, %perm0 = %perm : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, %out0 = %out : !mo.tensor<[3, 2], f32>} {
      %idx_ = map.index.transpose<#map.index.transpose.spec<[2, 3] -> [3, 2], perm = [1, 0]>> (%idx, %perm0)
          : (!map.index<2>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>) -> !map.index<2>
      %val = map.load %input0[%idx_] : !mo.tensor<[2, 3], f32>
      map.store %out0[%idx] = %val : !mo.tensor<[3, 2], f32>
    }
  } {device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>}
  mo.output %output : !mo.tensor<[3, 2], f32>
}

// 3D permutation: out.dim[i] = in.dim[perm[i]] for perm = [2, 0, 1].

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @transpose3D
// CHECK:         [[RESULT2:%[^ ]+]] = map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:    inputs ([[INPUT2:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>, [[PERM2:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[3], si64>)
// CHECK-NEXT:    outputs ([[OUT2:%[^ :,]+]] : !mo.tensor<[4, 2, 3], f32>) {
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[STRIDED2:%[^ ]+]] = map.index.transpose.stride<#map.index.transpose.spec<[2, 3, 4] -> [4, 2, 3], perm = [2, 0, 1]>> ([[INPUT2]], [[PERM2]])
// CHECK-NEXT:      map.iter.elementwise.body<[4, 2, 3]>
// CHECK-NEXT:        index   ([[IDX2:%[^ :,]+]]: !map.index<3>)
// CHECK-NEXT:        capturing {{{.*}}[[OUT02:%[^ ,]+]] = [[OUT2]] : !mo.tensor<[4, 2, 3], f32>, [[NEWCAP2:%[^ ]+]] = [[STRIDED2]] : !mo.tensor<[4, 2, 3], f32>} {
// CHECK-NOT:       map.index.transpose
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[VAL2:%[^ ]+]] = map.load [[NEWCAP2]]{{\[}}[[IDX2]]] : !mo.tensor<[4, 2, 3], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:      map.store [[OUT02]]{{\[}}[[IDX2]]] = [[VAL2]] : !mo.tensor<[4, 2, 3], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:    }
mo.graph @transpose3D(%input: !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>, %perm: !mo.tensor<[3], si64>)
    -> !mo.tensor<[4, 2, 3], f32> {
  %output = map.iter.opaque
      inputs (%input : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>, %perm : !mo.tensor<[3], si64>)
      outputs (%out : !mo.tensor<[4, 2, 3], f32>) {
    map.iter.elementwise.body<[4, 2, 3]>
        index (%idx: !map.index<3>)
        capturing {%input0 = %input : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>, %perm0 = %perm : !mo.tensor<[3], si64>, %out0 = %out : !mo.tensor<[4, 2, 3], f32>} {
      %idx_ = map.index.transpose<#map.index.transpose.spec<[2, 3, 4] -> [4, 2, 3], perm = [2, 0, 1]>> (%idx, %perm0)
          : (!map.index<3>, !mo.tensor<[3], si64>) -> !map.index<3>
      %val = map.load %input0[%idx_] : !mo.tensor<[2, 3, 4], f32>
      map.store %out0[%idx] = %val : !mo.tensor<[4, 2, 3], f32>
    }
  } {device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>}
  mo.output %output : !mo.tensor<[4, 2, 3], f32>
}

}

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @add_gather
// CHECK-SAME:  (%[[A:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, %[[B:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, %[[INDICES:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:  %[[OUT:.*]] = map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs (%[[INDICES]]: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>, %[[A]]: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, %[[B]]: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:  outputs (%{{.*}} : !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>) {
// CHECK-NEXT:  %[[PD:.*]] = map.iter.prologue (%{{.*}} : !map.index<2>) capturing {%[[CA:.*]] = %[[A]] : !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, %[[CB:.*]] = %[[B]] : !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>}
// CHECK-NEXT:  %[[AV:.*]] = map.load %[[CA]][%{{.*}}] : !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:  %[[BV:.*]] = map.load %[[CB]][%{{.*}}] : !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>

// CHECK-NEXT:  %{{.*}} = map.load %[[CI]][%{{.*}}] : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>
// CHECK-NEXT:  map.yield
// CHECK:       map.call.opaque @{{.*}}.Gather{{.*}} inputs(%[[PD]], %[[PI]])
// CHECK:       #mogg.fusion_prologue<[#mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.add"

) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32> {
  %data = mo.add(%a, %b) : !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>
  %out = mo.gather(%data, %indices) [axis = 0] : (!mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>

// CHECK:       map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Add(%{{.*}}) : !map.index<2>, si32, si32 -> si32

mo.graph @partial_fused_inputs(

  %p1 = mo.mul(%c, %d) : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
  %out = mo.custom [symbol = "map_lower_partial_fused_inputs", device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>](%p0, %p1) : (!mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @fuse_in_if
// CHECK:       mo.if
// CHECK:       map.iter.opaque
// CHECK:       map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Add
// CHECK:       #mogg.fusion_prologue<[#mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.add"
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       } else {
// CHECK:       map.iter.opaque
// CHECK:       map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Mul
// CHECK:       #mogg.fusion_prologue<[#mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.mul"
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       mo.output
mo.graph @fuse_in_if(
  %a: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>,
  %b: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>,
  %indices: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>,
  %cond: !mo.tensor<[], bool>
) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32> {
  %res = mo.if (%cond : !mo.tensor<[], bool>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32> {
    %data = mo.add(%a, %b) : !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>
    %out = mo.gather(%data, %indices) [axis = 0] : (!mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>
    mo.yield %out : !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>
  } else {
    %data = mo.mul(%a, %b) : !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>
    %out = mo.gather(%data, %indices) [axis = 0] : (!mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>
    mo.yield %out : !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>
  }
  mo.output %res : !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>
}

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @no_fuse_across_blocks
// CHECK:       %[[EW:.*]] = map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Add
// CHECK:       mo.if
// CHECK:       map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs (%[[EW]]: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, %{{.*}}: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>)
// CHECK-NOT:   map.call.elementwise
// CHECK:       #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.gather"
mo.graph @no_fuse_across_blocks(
  %a: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>,
  %b: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>,
  %indices: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>,
  %cond: !mo.tensor<[], bool>
) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32> {
  %data = mo.add(%a, %b) : !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>
  %res = mo.if (%cond : !mo.tensor<[], bool>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32> {
    %out = mo.gather(%data, %indices) [axis = 0] : (!mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>
    mo.yield %out : !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>
  } else {
    %z = mo.gather(%a, %indices) [axis = 0] : (!mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>
    mo.yield %z : !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>
  }
  mo.output %res : !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>
}

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @no_fuse_multi_use
// CHECK:       %[[EW:.*]] = map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Add
// CHECK:       %[[G:.*]] = map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs (%[[EW]]: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, %{{.*}}: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>)
// CHECK-NOT:   map.call.elementwise
// CHECK:       #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.gather"
// CHECK:       mo.output %[[G]], %[[EW]]
mo.graph @no_fuse_multi_use(
  %a: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>,
  %b: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>,
  %indices: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>
) -> (!mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>, !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>) {
  %data = mo.add(%a, %b) : !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>
  %out = mo.gather(%data, %indices) [axis = 0] : (!mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], si32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>
  mo.output %out, %data : !mo.tensor<[2, 2, 3], f32>, !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>
}

// Feeds both operands, so not fused; the duplicate inputs are `--canonicalize`'s.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @no_fuse_same_producer_twice
// CHECK:       %[[EW:.*]] = map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Add
// CHECK:       map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs (%[[EW]] as %{{.*}}: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>, %[[EW]] as %{{.*}}: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>)
// CHECK-NOT:   map.call.elementwise
// CHECK:       #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"custom__map_lower_two_fused_inputs"
mo.graph @no_fuse_same_producer_twice(
  %a: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>,
  %b: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32> {
  %p = mo.add(%a, %b) : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
  %out = mo.custom [symbol = "map_lower_two_fused_inputs", device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>](%p, %p) : (!mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
  mo.output %out : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
}

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @no_fuse_plain_input
// CHECK:       %[[EW:.*]] = map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Add
// CHECK:       map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.prologue
// CHECK:       map.call.opaque @{{.*}}.Matmul{{.*}} inputs(%[[EW]], %{{.*}})
mo.graph @no_fuse_plain_input(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>,
  %y: !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>,
  %z: !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>
) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32> {
  %p = mo.add(%x, %y) : !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>
  %out = mo.matmul(%p, %z) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>
  mo.output %out : !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>
}
GraphCompiler/test/mo-opt/MAPDialect/Transforms/RaiseBackContiguousViews/raise-back-contiguous-views.mlir · complete source
// RUN: mo-opt %s --mogg-import-packages --mo-to-map --map-raise-back-contiguous-views | FileCheck %s

// RaiseBackContiguousViews raises an unfused, contiguous slice back to
// mogg.slice (zero-copy) and an unfused reshape back to mo.static.reshape
// (unconditionally -- MOGGToMGP always turns it into a non-copying
// primitive). A slice that isn't contiguous, or a view kind out of scope
// (broadcast/transpose), is left as a map.iter.elementwise for the ordinary MAP
// pipeline to handle.

// Only the leading dim is sliced; the trailing dim keeps its full extent --
// the common case of "the sliced dim is the first non-1 input dim".

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @contiguousSliceLeadingDim
// CHECK-NOT:     map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:         [[START:%.*]] = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<1> : !M.array<1xsi64>>
// CHECK:         [[STOP:%.*]] = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<4> : !M.array<1xsi64>>
// CHECK:         mogg.slice(%arg0, [[START]], [[STOP]]) : (!mo.tensor<[10, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[], si64>, !mo.tensor<[], si64>) -> !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32>
mo.graph @contiguousSliceLeadingDim(%input: !mo.tensor<[10, 64], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32> {
  %start = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<1, 0> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %stop = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<4, 64> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %step = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<1, 1> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %res = mo.slice(%input, %start, %stop, %step) : (
    !mo.tensor<[10, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  ) -> !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32>
  mo.output %res : !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32>
}

// Leading size-1 dims are skipped when locating "the" sliced dimension: here
// dim 0 has size 1 and is untouched, dim 1 is the one actually sliced.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @contiguousSliceSkipLeadingOnes
// CHECK-NOT:     map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:         mogg.slice(%arg0, %{{.*}}, %{{.*}}) : (!mo.tensor<[1, 10, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[], si64>, !mo.tensor<[], si64>) -> !mo.tensor<[1, 3, 64], f32>
mo.graph @contiguousSliceSkipLeadingOnes(%input: !mo.tensor<[1, 10, 64], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[1, 3, 64], f32> {
  %start = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<0, 1, 0> : tensor<3xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[3], si64>
  %stop = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<1, 4, 64> : tensor<3xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[3], si64>
  %step = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<1, 1, 1> : tensor<3xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[3], si64>
  %res = mo.slice(%input, %start, %stop, %step) : (
    !mo.tensor<[1, 10, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[3], si64>, !mo.tensor<[3], si64>, !mo.tensor<[3], si64>
  ) -> !mo.tensor<[1, 3, 64], f32>
  mo.output %res : !mo.tensor<[1, 3, 64], f32>
}

// Both dims change (not contiguous along a single dim): left as a
// map.iter.elementwise for the general MAPToMOGG zero-copy strided-view path.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @nonContiguousMultiDimSlice
// CHECK-NOT:     mogg.slice
// CHECK:         map.iter.elementwise<[3, 32]>
// CHECK:         map.index.slice<#map.index.slice.spec<[10, 64] -> [3, 32], starts = [1, 32], stops = [4, 64], steps = [1, 1]>>
mo.graph @nonContiguousMultiDimSlice(%input: !mo.tensor<[10, 64], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[3, 32], f32> {
  %start = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<1, 32> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %stop = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<4, 64> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %step = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<1, 1> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %res = mo.slice(%input, %start, %stop, %step) : (
    !mo.tensor<[10, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  ) -> !mo.tensor<[3, 32], f32>
  mo.output %res : !mo.tensor<[3, 32], f32>
}

// The sliced dim's start/stop aren't compile-time constants: left as a
// map.iter.elementwise (only step needs to be a literal 1 for the fusion
// permission check ViewFuser/ElementwiseFuser use elsewhere, but raising
// back to mogg.slice needs actual scalar values for its start/stop
// operands).

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @nonContiguousDynamicBounds
// CHECK-NOT:     mogg.slice
// CHECK:         map.iter.elementwise<[3, 64]>
// CHECK:         map.index.slice<#map.index.slice.spec<[10, 64] -> [3, 64], starts = [?, ?], stops = [?, ?], steps = [?, ?]>>
mo.graph @nonContiguousDynamicBounds(
    %input: !mo.tensor<[10, 64], f32>,
    %start: !mo.tensor<[2], si64>,
    %stop: !mo.tensor<[2], si64>,
    %step: !mo.tensor<[2], si64>)
    -> !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32> {
  %res = mo.slice(%input, %start, %stop, %step) : (
    !mo.tensor<[10, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  ) -> !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32>
  mo.output %res : !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32>
}

// A reshape is always raised back, unconditionally -- no contiguity check.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @reshapeAlwaysRaised
// CHECK-NOT:     map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:         mo.static.reshape(%arg0) : !mo.tensor<[4, 6], f32> -> !mo.tensor<[24], f32>
mo.graph @reshapeAlwaysRaised(%input: !mo.tensor<[4, 6], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[24], f32> {
  %res = mo.static.reshape(%input) : !mo.tensor<[4, 6], f32> -> !mo.tensor<[24], f32>
  mo.output %res : !mo.tensor<[24], f32>
}

// A contiguous slice inside an `mo.if` branch still raises: the pass walks
// rather than iterates the graph's direct ops, so a view kernel nested in
// control flow isn't missed.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @contiguousSliceInsideIf
// CHECK:         mo.if
// CHECK-NOT:     map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:         mogg.slice(%arg0, %{{.*}}, %{{.*}}) : (!mo.tensor<[10, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[], si64>, !mo.tensor<[], si64>) -> !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32>
// CHECK:         } else {
mo.graph @contiguousSliceInsideIf(
    %input: !mo.tensor<[10, 64], f32>,
    %cond: !mo.tensor<[], bool>
) -> !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32> {
  %start = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<1, 0> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %stop = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<4, 64> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %step = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<1, 1> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %res = mo.if (%cond : !mo.tensor<[], bool>) -> !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32> {
    %sliced = mo.slice(%input, %start, %stop, %step) : (
      !mo.tensor<[10, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
    ) -> !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32>
    mo.yield %sliced : !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32>
  } else {
    %sliced = mo.slice(%input, %start, %stop, %step) : (
      !mo.tensor<[10, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
    ) -> !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32>
    mo.yield %sliced : !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32>
  }
  mo.output %res : !mo.tensor<[3, 64], f32>
}

// Broadcast is out of scope (matches the legacy raise-back's own scope):
// left as a map.iter.elementwise even though it is unfused.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @broadcastNotRaised
// CHECK:         map.iter.elementwise<[8, 64]>
// CHECK:         map.index.broadcast<#map.index.broadcast.spec<[1, 64] -> [8, 64]>>
mo.graph @broadcastNotRaised(%input: !mo.tensor<[1, 64], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 64], f32> {
  %res = mo.static.broadcast_to(%input) : !mo.tensor<[1, 64], f32> -> !mo.tensor<[8, 64], f32>
  mo.output %res : !mo.tensor<[8, 64], f32>
}
GraphCompiler/test/mo-opt/MAPDialect/Transforms/ReductionFusion/consumers.mlir · complete source
// RUN: mo-opt %s --mogg-import-packages="mojo-pkg-paths=%kernel_api_test_pkg" --mo-to-map --map-fuse-reductions | FileCheck %s

// A consumer over the per-row space ([M, 1]) that reads a per-row result at
// its own index becomes row-level ops after the fold, indexed by the row. It
// reads the value the fold stored; its result becomes a rowwise output.

// The old output goes away once nothing else reads it. `%b` becomes a rowwise
// input, loaded at the row.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @chain
// CHECK-SAME:  (%[[X:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>, %[[B:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>)
// CHECK:       %[[R:.*]] = map.iter.rowwise<[8, 128], axis = 1>
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs  (%[[X]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>, %[[B]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:  outputs (%[[OUT:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:  row     (%[[ROW:.*]]: !map.index<2>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32> {
// CHECK-NEXT:    %[[ACC:.*]] = map.iter.reduce @builtin_kernels.monoids.ReduceSum
// CHECK:         }
// CHECK-NEXT:    %[[BV:.*]] = map.load %[[B]][%[[ROW]]] : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:    %[[Y:.*]] = map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Add(%[[ROW]], %[[ACC]], %[[BV]])
// CHECK-NEXT:    %[[Z:.*]] = map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Exp(%[[ROW]], %[[Y]])
// CHECK-NEXT:    map.store %[[OUT]][%[[ROW]]] = %[[Z]] : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:  }
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       mo.output %[[R]]
mo.graph @chain(%x: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>, %b: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32> {
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  %y = mo.add(%r, %b) : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  %z = mo.exp(%y) : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  mo.output %z : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
}

// A result that is also a graph output stays, next to the consumer's.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @sideOutput
// CHECK:       %[[R2:.*]]:2 = map.iter.rowwise<[8, 128], axis = 1>
// CHECK:       outputs (%[[O0:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>, %[[O1:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>)
// CHECK:       %[[ACC2:.*]] = map.iter.reduce
// CHECK:       map.store %[[O0]][%[[ROW2:.*]]] = %[[ACC2]]
// CHECK-NEXT:  %[[E:.*]] = map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Exp(%[[ROW2]], %[[ACC2]])
// CHECK-NEXT:  map.store %[[O1]][%[[ROW2]]] = %[[E]]
// CHECK:       mo.output %[[R2]]#1, %[[R2]]#0
mo.graph @sideOutput(%x: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> (!mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>) {
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  %z = mo.exp(%r) : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  mo.output %z, %r : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
}

// A multi-field monoid: the consumer reads one field, whose output goes away;
// the other stays, ahead of the consumer's new output.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @oneField
// CHECK:       %[[R3:.*]]:2 = map.iter.rowwise<[4, 16], axis = 1>
// CHECK:       outputs (%[[OI:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[4, 1], si64>, %[[ON:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[4, 1], f32>)
// CHECK:       %[[VALS:.*]], %[[IDXS:.*]] = map.iter.reduce @builtin_kernels.monoids.ArgMax
// CHECK:       map.store %[[OI]][{{.*}}] = %[[IDXS]]
// CHECK-NEXT:  %[[N:.*]] = map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Negative({{.*}}, %[[VALS]])
// CHECK-NEXT:  map.store %[[ON]][{{.*}}] = %[[N]]
// CHECK:       mo.output %[[R3]]#1, %[[R3]]#0
mo.graph @oneField(%x: !mo.tensor<[4, 16], f32>) -> (!mo.tensor<[4, 1], f32>, !mo.tensor<[4, 1], si64>) {
  %v, %i = mo.custom [symbol = "mo.reduce.arg_max.tmp", device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>](%x) : (!mo.tensor<[4, 16], f32>) -> (!mo.tensor<[4, 1], f32>, !mo.tensor<[4, 1], si64>)
  %n = mo.negative(%v) : !mo.tensor<[4, 1], f32>
  mo.output %n, %i : !mo.tensor<[4, 1], f32>, !mo.tensor<[4, 1], si64>
}

// The consumer's other input is computed after the reduction, so the rowwise
// moves down to it. That input's producer then fuses at the row too.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @sinksPastInput
// CHECK-SAME:  (%[[X4:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>, %[[B4:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>)
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       map.iter.rowwise<[8, 128], axis = 1>
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs  (%[[X4]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>, %[[B4]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>)
// CHECK:       map.load %[[B4]][%[[ROW4:[[:alnum:]_]+]]]
// CHECK:       %[[BB:.*]] = map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Mul(%[[ROW4]],
// CHECK-NEXT:  map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Add(%[[ROW4]], {{.*}}, %[[BB]])
mo.graph @sinksPastInput(%x: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>, %b: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32> {
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  %bb = mo.mul(%b, %b) : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  %y = mo.add(%r, %bb) : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  mo.output %y : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
}

// The consumer's other input depends on the rowwise through another kernel,
// a cycle: it stays out.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @cycle
// CHECK:       %[[R5:.*]] = map.iter.rowwise<[8, 128], axis = 1>
// CHECK:       %[[T:.*]] = map.iter.rowwise<[8, 1], axis = 0>
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs  (%[[R5]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>)
// CHECK:       map.iter.elementwise<[8, 1]>
// CHECK:       inputs  (%[[R5]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>, %{{.*}}: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>)
mo.graph @cycle(%x: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32> {
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  %t = mo.reduce.max(%r) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[1, 1], f32>
  %tb = mo.static.broadcast_to(%t) : !mo.tensor<[1, 1], f32> -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  %y = mo.div(%r, %tb) : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  mo.output %y : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
}

// A consumer over the full row space is a later step: it stays out.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @fullRow
// CHECK:       %[[R6:.*]] = map.iter.rowwise<[8, 128], axis = 1>
// CHECK:       map.iter.elementwise<[8, 128]>
mo.graph @fullRow(%x: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32> {
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  %rb = mo.static.broadcast_to(%r) : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32> -> !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>
  %d = mo.div(%x, %rb) : !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>
  mo.output %d : !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>
}

// A consumer reading the result through an index transform (here, rows in
// reverse) stays out.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @transformedRead
// CHECK:       map.iter.rowwise<[8, 8], axis = 1>
// CHECK:       map.iter.elementwise<[8, 1]>
// CHECK:       map.index.slice
mo.graph @transformedRead(%x: !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32> {
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  %start = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<7, 0> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %stop = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<-9, 1> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %step = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<-1, 1> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %s = mo.slice(%r, %start, %stop, %step) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  mo.output %s : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
}

// A `mo.mutable.store` of a per-row result stores into its buffer from the
// rowwise, which then writes memory no result names.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @mutableStore(
// CHECK:       map.iter.rowwise<[8, 128], axis = 1>
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs (%{{.*}}: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>, %[[BUF:.*]]: !mo.buffer<[8, 1], f32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:  outputs ()
// CHECK-NEXT:  row (%[[ROW:.*]]: !map.index<2>) -> () {
// CHECK:       %[[V:.*]] = map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}MutableStore(%[[ROW]], %{{.*}})
// CHECK-NEXT:  map.store %[[BUF]][%[[ROW]]] = %[[V]] : !mo.buffer<[8, 1], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:  } {{{.*}}hasWriteEffect = true}
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       mo.output
mo.graph @mutableStore(%x: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>, %buf: !mo.buffer<[8, 1], f32>) {
  %chain = mo.chain.create()
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  %c = mo.mutable.store(%buf, %r, %chain) : (!mo.buffer<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.chain) -> !mo.chain
  mo.output
}

// A store whose chain is used stays its own kernel: the rowwise holds no
// chain to carry the ordering.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @mutableStoreChainUsed
// CHECK:       map.iter.rowwise
// CHECK:       map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}MutableStore
mo.graph @mutableStoreChainUsed(%x: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>, %buf: !mo.buffer<[8, 1], f32>) -> !mo.chain {
  %chain = mo.chain.create()
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  %c = mo.mutable.store(%buf, %r, %chain) : (!mo.buffer<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.chain) -> !mo.chain
  mo.output %c : !mo.chain
}

// A store ordered after another store keeps its own kernel: the rowwise
// holds no chain to order it after the first store.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @mutableStoreAfterStore
// CHECK:       map.iter.rowwise
// CHECK:       map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}MutableStore
mo.graph @mutableStoreAfterStore(%x: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>, %a: !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>, %buf: !mo.buffer<[8, 1], f32>) {
  %c0 = mo.chain.create()
  %c1 = mo.mutable.store(%buf, %a, %c0) : (!mo.buffer<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.chain) -> !mo.chain
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  %c2 = mo.mutable.store(%buf, %r, %c1) : (!mo.buffer<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.chain) -> !mo.chain
  mo.output
}

// RUN: mo-opt --mlir-print-local-scope %s --mogg-import-packages="mojo-pkg-paths=%kernel_api_test_pkg" --mo-to-map --map-fuse-reductions | FileCheck %s

// A producer only a rowwise reads is cloned into the fold at the load's index,
// and the fold reads the producer's inputs instead.

// A chain: `mul` fuses first, which leaves `cast` read only by the rowwise.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @chain
// CHECK-SAME:  (%[[X:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], bf16>)
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       map.iter.rowwise<[8, 128], axis = 1>
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs  (%[[X]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], bf16>)
// CHECK:       map.iter.reduce @builtin_kernels.monoids.ReduceSum index (%[[I:.*]]: !map.index<2>) -> f32 {
// CHECK-NEXT:    %[[V:.*]] = map.load %[[X]][%[[I]]] : !mo.tensor<[8, 128], bf16>
// CHECK-NEXT:    %[[A:.*]] = map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Cast(%[[I]], %[[V]])
// CHECK-NEXT:    %[[SQ:.*]] = map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Mul(%[[I]], %[[A]], %[[A]])
// CHECK-NEXT:    map.yield %[[SQ]] : f32
// CHECK:       fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_rowwise<[#mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.cast"{{.*}}, #mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.mul"{{.*}}, #mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.reduce.add"
mo.graph @chain(%x: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], bf16>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32> {
  %a = mo.cast(%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 128], bf16>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>
  %sq = mo.mul(%a, %a) : !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%sq) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  mo.output %r : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
}

// A view producer: the broadcast index lands inside the fold.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @broadcastGamma
// CHECK-SAME:  (%[[X2:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>, %[[G:.*]]: !mo.tensor<[128], f32>)
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       map.iter.reduce @builtin_kernels.monoids.ReduceMax index (%[[I2:.*]]: !map.index<2>) -> f32 {
// CHECK-NEXT:    %[[XV:.*]] = map.load %[[X2]][%[[I2]]]
// CHECK-NEXT:    %[[GI:.*]] = map.index.broadcast<#map.index.broadcast.spec<[128] -> [8, 128]>> (%[[I2]])
// CHECK-NEXT:    %[[GV:.*]] = map.load %[[G]][%[[GI]]] : !mo.tensor<[128], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:    map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Mul(%[[I2]], %[[XV]], %[[GV]])
mo.graph @broadcastGamma(%x: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>, %g: !mo.tensor<[128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32> {
  %gb = mo.static.broadcast_to(%g) : !mo.tensor<[128], f32> -> !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>
  %xg = mo.mul(%x, %gb) : !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>
  %r = mo.reduce.max(%xg) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  mo.output %r : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
}

// A non-inner axis.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @outerAxis
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       map.iter.rowwise<[M, N], axis = 0>
// CHECK:       map.iter.reduce @builtin_kernels.monoids.ReduceSum
// CHECK:       map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Exp
mo.graph @outerAxis<M, N>(%x: !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[1, N], f32> {
  %e = mo.exp(%x) : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%e) : (!mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[1, N], f32>
  mo.output %r : !mo.tensor<[1, N], f32>
}

// A producer another kernel also reads stays materialized.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @sharedProducer
// CHECK:       %[[SQ2:.*]] = map.iter.elementwise<[8, 128]>
// CHECK:       map.iter.rowwise<[8, 128], axis = 1>
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs  (%[[SQ2]]: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>)
mo.graph @sharedProducer(%x: !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> (!mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) {
  %sq = mo.mul(%x, %x) : !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%sq) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>
  mo.output %r, %sq : !mo.tensor<[8, 1], f32>, !mo.tensor<[8, 128], f32>
}

// Reshape barrier, as in input fusion: once the reshape fuses, the fold's
// load crosses it, so the slice above it stays its own kernel and writes a
// contiguous tensor.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @sliceThenReshape
// CHECK:       %[[S:.*]] = map.iter.elementwise<[16, 32]>
// CHECK:       map.index.slice
// CHECK:       map.iter.rowwise<[4, 4, 32], axis = 1>
// CHECK-NEXT:  inputs  (%[[S]]: !mo.tensor<[16, 32], f32>)
// CHECK:       map.index.reshape
// CHECK-NOT:   map.index.slice
// CHECK:       mo.output
mo.graph @sliceThenReshape(%x: !mo.tensor<[16, 64], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[4, 1, 32], f32> {
  %start = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<0, 32> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %stop = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<16, 64> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %step = mo.constant <#M.dense_array<1, 1> : tensor<2xsi64>> : !mo.tensor<[2], si64>
  %s = mo.slice(%x, %start, %stop, %step) : (!mo.tensor<[16, 64], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>, !mo.tensor<[2], si64>) -> !mo.tensor<[16, 32], f32>
  %g = mo.static.reshape(%s) : !mo.tensor<[16, 32], f32> -> !mo.tensor<[4, 4, 32], f32>
  %r = mo.reduce.add(%g) : (!mo.tensor<[4, 4, 32], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[4, 1, 32], f32>
  mo.output %r : !mo.tensor<[4, 1, 32], f32>
}
GraphCompiler/test/mo-opt/MAPDialect/Transforms/ReshapeEpilogueFusion/reshape_epilogue_fusion.mlir · complete source
// RUN: mo-opt --mlir-print-local-scope %s --mogg-import-packages="mojo-pkg-paths=%kernel_api_test_lib" --mo-to-map --map-fuse-kernels | FileCheck %s

// A reshape between a (non-accumulating) fused-output kernel and an add fuses
// into the producer's epilogue: ElementwiseFuser folds the reshape into the
// add, then ReshapeEpilogueFuser relocates it onto the producer's epilogue as
// a swapped `map.index.reshape` on the STORE index. Only the store DESTINATION
// is retyped to [64]; the epilogue RESULT (what the kernel binds) keeps the
// producer's [8, 8] shape. The bias load and store both use the reshaped
// index. (An accumulating producer -- matmul/conv/concat -- is declined, since
// it would touch the null-pointer fused-output slice; see ReshapeEpilogueFuser.)

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @custom_reshape_add
// CHECK:       %[[OUT:.*]] = map.iter.opaque
// CHECK:       outputs (%{{.*}} : !mo.tensor<[64], f32>) {
// CHECK:       map.iter.epilogue (%[[VAL:.*]] : f32, %[[IDX:.*]] : !map.index<2>)
// CHECK:       %[[SIDX:.*]] = map.index.reshape<#map.index.reshape.spec<[64] -> [8, 8]>>
// CHECK:       %[[BV:.*]] = map.load %{{.*}}[%[[SIDX]]] : !mo.tensor<[64], f32>
// CHECK:       %[[ADD:.*]] = map.call.elementwise @{{.*}}.Add(%{{.*}}, %[[VAL]], %[[BV]])
// CHECK:       map.store %{{.*}}[%[[SIDX]]] = %[[ADD]] : !mo.tensor<[64], f32>
// CHECK:       map.call.opaque @{{.*}}MapLowerOneFusedOutput
// CHECK:       fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_epilogue<[#mogg.fusion_leaf<"custom__map_lower_one_fused_output"
// CHECK-NOT:   map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       mo.output %[[OUT]] : !mo.tensor<[64], f32>
mo.graph @custom_reshape_add(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>,
  %z: !mo.tensor<[64], f32>
) -> !mo.tensor<[64], f32> {
  %c = mo.custom [symbol = "map_lower_one_fused_output", device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>](%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>
  %r = mo.static.reshape(%c) : !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32> -> !mo.tensor<[64], f32>
  %out = mo.add(%r, %z) : !mo.tensor<[64], f32>
  mo.output %out : !mo.tensor<[64], f32>
}

// A pure reshape (no downstream elementwise op to unlock) is left alone -- a
// no-op relabel in MGP -- so it stays its own view kernel.

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @custom_reshape_only
// CHECK:       map.iter.opaque
// CHECK:       map.iter.elementwise
// CHECK:       map.index.reshape<#map.index.reshape.spec<[8, 8] -> [64]>>
mo.graph @custom_reshape_only(
  %x: !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>
) -> !mo.tensor<[64], f32> {
  %c = mo.custom [symbol = "map_lower_one_fused_output", device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>](%x) : (!mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32>
  %r = mo.static.reshape(%c) : !mo.tensor<[8, 8], f32> -> !mo.tensor<[64], f32>
  mo.output %r : !mo.tensor<[64], f32>
}

// RUN: mo-opt --mlir-print-local-scope %s --map-outline-structured-kernel-bodies | FileCheck %s

!DType = !lit.struct<@std::@builtin::@dtype::@DType>
!SIMDLength = !lit.struct<@std::@builtin::@simd_length::@SIMDLength>
#SIMD = #lit<symbol@std::@builtin::@simd::@SIMD>

module {

// map.call.elementwise verifies its callee resolves to a mogg.kernel.decl
// with an `elementwise` function, so this stub must be present.
mogg.kernel.decl @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Add registration = "mo.add" device_info = <"", "", "", ""> elementwise = <<!lit.generator<<"dtype": !DType, "width": !SIMDLength>("lhs": !lit.struct<#SIMD <:!DType *(0,0), :!SIMDLength *(0,1)>>, "rhs": !lit.struct<#SIMD <:!DType *(0,0), :!SIMDLength *(0,1)>>) -> !lit.struct<#SIMD <:!DType *(0,0), :!SIMDLength *(0,1)>>>>, [#kgen<param.decl dtype : !DType>, #kgen<param.decl width : !SIMDLength>], [{dtype = #kgen.param.decl.ref<"dtype"> : !DType, size = #kgen.param.decl.ref<"width"> : !SIMDLength}, {dtype = #kgen.param.decl.ref<"dtype"> : !DType, size = #kgen.param.decl.ref<"width"> : !SIMDLength}], [{dtype = #kgen.param.decl.ref<"dtype"> : !DType, size = #kgen.param.decl.ref<"width"> : !SIMDLength}]> struct_params = [] is_user_defined = false

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @add
// CHECK:         [[RESULT:%[^ ]+]] = map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:    inputs ([[X:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>, [[Y:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:    outputs ([[OUT:%[^ :,]+]] : !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>) {
// CHECK-NEXT:      map.iter.elementwise.body<[256, 256]>
// CHECK-NEXT:        index   ([[IDX:%[^ :,]+]]: !map.index<2>)
// CHECK-NEXT:        capturing {[[X0:%[^ ,]+]] = [[X]] : !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>, [[Y0:%[^ ,]+]] = [[Y]] : !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>, [[OUT0:%[^ ,]+]] = [[OUT]] : !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>} {
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[XV:%[^ ]+]] = map.load [[X0]][[[IDX]]] : !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[YV:%[^ ]+]] = map.load [[Y0]][[[IDX]]] : !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[RES:%[^ ]+]] = map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Add([[IDX]], [[XV]], [[YV]]) : !map.index<2>, f32, f32 -> f32
// CHECK-NEXT:      map.store [[OUT0]][[[IDX]]] = [[RES]] : !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:    }
// CHECK-NEXT:  } {device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>, fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.add">>, hasReadEffect = false, hasWriteEffect = false}
// CHECK-NEXT:  mo.output [[RESULT]] : !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>
mo.graph @add(%arg0: !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>, %arg1: !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32> {
  %0 = map.iter.elementwise<[256, 256]>
      inputs  (%arg0: !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>, %arg1: !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>)
      outputs (%out: !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>)
      index   (%idx: !map.index<2>)
      -> !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>
  {
    %xv = map.load %arg0[%idx] : !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>
    %yv = map.load %arg1[%idx] : !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>
    %outv = map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Add(%idx, %xv, %yv)
                : !map.index<2>, f32, f32 -> f32
    map.store %out[%idx] = %outv : !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>
  } {fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.add">>, hasReadEffect = false, hasWriteEffect = false}
  mo.output %0 : !mo.tensor<[256, 256], f32>
}

// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @addDynamic
// CHECK:         [[RESULT2:%[^ ]+]] = map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:    inputs ([[X2:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>, [[Y2:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:    outputs ([[OUT2:%[^ :,]+]] : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>) {
// CHECK-NEXT:      map.iter.elementwise.body<[M, N]>
// CHECK-NEXT:        index   ([[IDX2:%[^ :,]+]]: !map.index<2>)
// CHECK-NEXT:        capturing {[[X02:%[^ ,]+]] = [[X2]] : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>, [[Y02:%[^ ,]+]] = [[Y2]] : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>, [[OUT02:%[^ ,]+]] = [[OUT2]] : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>} {
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[XV2:%[^ ]+]] = map.load [[X02]][[[IDX2]]] : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[YV2:%[^ ]+]] = map.load [[Y02]][[[IDX2]]] : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:      [[RES2:%[^ ]+]] = map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Add([[IDX2]], [[XV2]], [[YV2]]) : !map.index<2>, f32, f32 -> f32
// CHECK-NEXT:      map.store [[OUT02]][[[IDX2]]] = [[RES2]] : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>
// CHECK-NEXT:    }
// CHECK-NEXT:  } {device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>, fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.add">>, hasReadEffect = false, hasWriteEffect = false}
// CHECK-NEXT:  mo.output [[RESULT2]] : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>
mo.graph @addDynamic<M, N>(%arg0: !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>, %arg1: !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32> {
  %0 = map.iter.elementwise<[M, N]>
      inputs  (%arg0: !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>, %arg1: !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>)
      outputs (%out: !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>)
      index   (%idx: !map.index<2>)
      -> !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>
  {
    %xv = map.load %arg0[%idx] : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>
    %yv = map.load %arg1[%idx] : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>
    %outv = map.call.elementwise @builtin_kernels.elementwise.Add(%idx, %xv, %yv)
                : !map.index<2>, f32, f32 -> f32
    map.store %out[%idx] = %outv : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>
  } {fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"mo.add">>, hasReadEffect = false, hasWriteEffect = false}
  mo.output %0 : !mo.tensor<[M, N], f32>
}

// map.iter.opaque is left untouched.
// CHECK-LABEL: mo.graph @alreadyOpaque
// CHECK:         [[RESULT3:%[^ ]+]] = map.iter.opaque
// CHECK-NEXT:    inputs ([[X3:%[^ :,]+]]: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>)
// CHECK-NEXT:    outputs ([[OUT3:%[^ :,]+]] : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) {
// CHECK-NEXT:  }
// CHECK-NEXT:  mo.output [[RESULT3]] : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
mo.graph @alreadyOpaque(%arg0: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32> {
  %0 = map.iter.opaque inputs (%arg0 : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) outputs (%out : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) {
  } {device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>}
  mo.output %0 : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
}

}
